steps.step: 4. Add Objects via Navigate and Learn
details:
**Navigate and Learn Feature:**

```vbscript
1. Object → Navigate and Learn

2. Configure learning options:
   - Learn all objects: Yes
   - Filter by class: WebEdit, WebButton
   - Max objects: 100
   - Timeout: 10 seconds

3. Click Start

4. Navigate through application:
   - Click through pages
   - Open dialogs
   - Hover over elements

5. UFT learns objects automatically:
   - Progress bar shows
   - Objects appear in tree
   - Properties captured

6. Click Stop when done

7. Review learned objects:
   - Rename as needed
   - Remove unwanted
   - Organize in folders

8. Save repository
```

**Learning Settings:**
```
Learn Only:
[✓] Visible objects
[✓] Enabled objects
[ ] Hidden objects
[ ] Disabled objects

Property Filter:
[✓] Mandatory properties
[✓] Assistive properties
[ ] All properties
```

**Manual Object Creation:**

```vbscript
1. Object → New Object

2. Select object class:
   - Web: Browser, Page, WebEdit, etc.
   - Windows: Window, Dialog, Button
   - Java: JavaWindow, JavaButton

3. Define object hierarchy:
   - Parent objects first
   - Add child objects
   - Set properties

4. Configure identification properties:
   - Add mandatory properties
   - Set values
   - Add assistive if needed

5. Test identification:
   - Click "Test"
   - Verify object found
   - Adjust properties if needed

6. Name and save

Example - Manual WebEdit:
Class: WebEdit
Name: "txtUsername"
Properties:
  - html tag: INPUT
  - name: username
  - type: text
```

**Repository Organization:**

```
ECommerce_Login.tsr
├── Pages
│   ├── LoginPage
│   │   ├── txtUsername (WebEdit)
│   │   ├── txtPassword (WebEdit)
│   │   ├── btnLogin (WebButton)
│   │   └── lnkForgotPassword (Link)
│   └── RegistrationPage
│       ├── txtEmail (WebEdit)
│       ├── txtFirstName (WebEdit)
│       └── btnRegister (WebButton)
├── Frames
│   ├── frmMain (Frame)
│   └── frmNavigation (Frame)
└── Common
    ├── btnSubmit (WebButton)
    ├── btnCancel (WebButton)
    └── lblStatus (WebElement)
```

**Organization Tips:**
- Use folders for pages/modules
- Group by functionality
- Follow naming conventions
- Keep hierarchy shallow
- Document complex objects

**Property Configuration:**

```vbscript
For each object, configure:

1. Mandatory Properties (must match):
   - html tag: INPUT
   - name: username
   - type: text

2. Assistive Properties (help identify):
   - class: form-control
   - max length: 50
   - title: Enter username

3. Ordinal Identifiers (when needed):
   - index: 2 (position in DOM)
   - location: 150,200 (x,y coordinates)
   - creation time: 3 (order created)

4. Visual Relations:
   - near object: lblUsername
   - inside object: frmLogin
   - before object: btnLogin

Property Weight:
├── Mandatory: Must match exactly
├── Assistive: Help differentiate
├── Optional: Used if needed
└── Visual: For AI-based identification
```

**Save and Validate:**

```vbscript
1. File → Save (Ctrl+S)
2. Provide description (optional)
3. Save to version control if used

Validation Steps:
1. Object → Validate Repository
   - Checks all objects
   - Reports missing objects
   - Lists property issues

2. Test with sample script:
   Set repo = RepositoriesCollection.Open("C:\Repos\Login.tsr")
   Set obj = repo.GetObject("LoginPage.txtUsername")
   If obj.Exist(5) Then
       MsgBox "Object validated"
   End If

3. Check object counts:
   - Total objects: 25
   - By class: WebEdit(8), WebButton(5)
   - By folder: LoginPage(5), Common(10)
```

content.title: Repository Maintenance and Updates
content.explanation:
**Keeping Repositories Current:**

**1. Adding New Objects**

```vbscript
' When application adds new features

' Method 1: Navigate and Learn (incremental)
1. Open repository in ORM
2. Object → Navigate and Learn
3. Select "Add to existing repository"
4. Navigate new features
5. New objects added automatically

' Method 2: Manual addition
1. Right-click target folder
2. New Object
3. Configure properties
4. Test and save
```

**2. Updating Object Properties**

```vbscript
' When application UI changes

' Identify changes needed:
1. Run tests → identify failures
2. Use Object Spy on current object
3. Compare with repository properties
4. Update as needed

' Update single object:
1. Select object in repository
2. View → Properties
3. Modify properties:
   - Update changed values
   - Add new identifiers
   - Remove obsolete properties
4. Click Apply
5. Test identification

' Bulk update using Update from Application:
1. Select object(s) to update
2. Right-click → Update from Application
3. Point to new object
4. Review suggested changes
5. Accept/reject updates
6. Save repository
```

**3. Removing Obsolete Objects**

```vbscript
' Clean up unused objects

' Find unused objects:
1. Tools → Repository Report
2. Generate usage report
3. Identify objects with zero references

' Safe removal:
1. Search in all tests for object name
2. Verify no dependencies
3. Archive if uncertain
4. Delete from repository
5. Update version control

' Bulk cleanup:
1. Tools → Repository Cleanup
2. Scan for unused objects
3. Review list
4. Select to delete
5. Confirm removal
```

**4. Merging Repositories**

```vbscript
' Combine multiple repositories

' Manual merge:
1. Open target repository
2. File → Import → From Repository
3. Select source repository
4. Choose objects to import
5. Resolve conflicts:
   - Rename conflicting objects
   - Overwrite existing
   - Skip duplicates
6. Save merged repository

' Automated merge with ORMTool:
ORMTool.exe /merge /source:repo1.tsr /target:repo2.tsr /output:merged.tsr

' Conflict resolution rules:
├── Same name, different properties → Rename
├── Same properties, different names → Keep both
├── Identical objects → Skip duplicate
└── Similar objects → Review manually
```

**5. Version Control Integration**

```vbscript
' Repository version control best practices

' Repository file structure:
Repositories/
├── Main/
│   ├── CommonControls.tsr (v1.0)
│   ├── LoginModule.tsr (v1.2)
│   └── CheckoutModule.tsr (v1.1)
├── Branches/
│   ├── FeatureX_Controls.tsr
│   └── Hotfix_Controls.tsr
└── Archive/
    ├── Old_CommonControls_v0.9.tsr
    └── Deprecated_Module.tsr

' Git integration:
git add Repositories/Main/*.tsr
git commit -m "Updated login page objects for new UI"
git tag repositories-v2.0

' Collaboration workflow:
1. Checkout repository
2. Make changes
3. Test changes
4. Commit with comments
5. Notify team
6. Update test associations
```

**6. Repository Documentation**

```vbscript
' Document your repositories

' Repository header:
'=============================================
' Repository: ECommerce_Login.tsr
' Version: 2.1
' Last Updated: 2025-03-02
' Owner: Automation Team
' Application: E-Commerce Portal v3.0
' Description: Login module objects
'=============================================

' Object documentation:
' Object: txtUsername
' Location: LoginPage → Credentials
' Description: Username input field
' Properties: name=username, type=text
' Last Verified: 2025-03-01
' Notes: Hidden when remember me checked

' Generate documentation:
1. File → Export → Documentation
2. Select format: HTML/PDF/XML
3. Include properties: Yes
4. Include screenshots: Optional
5. Generate report
```

**7. Repository Performance Optimization**

```vbscript
' Keep repositories fast and efficient

' Optimization tips:
1. Split large repositories (max 500 objects)
2. Use folders for organization
3. Avoid deep hierarchies
4. Remove unused objects regularly
5. Compact repository periodically

' Compact repository:
1. Open repository in ORM
2. File → Maintenance → Compact
3. Removes fragmentation
4. Reduces file size
5. Improves performance

' Performance metrics:
├── Load time: < 2 seconds
├── Object lookup: < 100ms
├── File size: < 10 MB per repository
├── Objects per repository: 200-500
└── Hierarchy depth: 3-4 levels
```

**8. Repository Backup Strategy**

```vbscript
' Protect your repository investment

' Backup schedule:
├── Daily: Incremental backups
├── Weekly: Full backup
├── Monthly: Archive version
├── Pre-major change: Snapshot
└── Post-major change: Verify backup

' Backup locations:
1. Local network (primary)
2. Cloud storage (secondary)
3. Version control (tertiary)
4. External drive (offline)

' Automated backup script:
@echo off
set BACKUP_DIR=D:\Backups\UFT_Repos\%DATE%
set REPO_DIR=C:\UFT\Repositories

mkdir %BACKUP_DIR%
copy %REPO_DIR%\*.tsr %BACKUP_DIR%
robocopy %REPO_DIR% %BACKUP_DIR% /MIR

echo Backup completed: %DATE% %TIME% >> backup.log
```

content.title: Using Object Repositories in Test Scripts

details:
**Association Methods:**

```vbscript
' Method 1: UI Association
1. Open test in UFT

3. Click Add
4. Browse to .tsr file

6. Click OK

' Method 2: Programmatic Association

steps.action: Use repository objects in test code
details:
**Object Access Syntax:**

```vbscript
' Basic syntax
[ParentObject].[ChildObject].Method

' Examples
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtUsername").Set "user1"
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtPassword").SetSecure "encrypted"
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebButton("btnLogin").Click

' Using with variables
Set loginPage = Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login")
loginPage.WebEdit("txtUsername").Set username
loginPage.WebEdit("txtPassword").SetSecure password
loginPage.WebButton("btnLogin").Click

' Check object existence
If Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtUsername").Exist(5) Then
    ' Object exists
Else
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Username field not found"
End If

' Get object properties
fieldType = Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtUsername").GetROProperty("type")
```

**Dynamic Object Strategies:**

```vbscript
' Strategy 1: Descriptive Programming
' (bypass repository for dynamic parts)
Browser("title:=ECommerce").Page("index:=0").WebEdit("name:=item_\d+").Set "value"

' Strategy 2: Regular expressions in repository
' In object properties, use regex:
Property: name
Value: product_\d+
Regular Expression: True

' Strategy 3: Programmatic modification
Set desc = Description.Create()
desc("html tag").Value = "INPUT"
desc("name").Value = "item_.*"
desc("name").RegularExpression = True

Set items = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects(desc)
For i = 0 to items.Count - 1
    items(i).Set "value" & i
Next

' Strategy 4: Index-based identification
' In repository: Use ordinal identifier
Ordinal Identifier: Index
Value: 0 (first matching object)
```

**Debugging Techniques:**

```vbscript
' 1. Highlight object
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtUsername").Highlight

' 2. Check object existence with timeout
If Not Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtUsername").Exist(5) Then
    MsgBox "Object not found within 5 seconds"
End If

' 3. Get runtime properties
Set obj = Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtUsername")
properties = Array("name", "type", "class", "value")
For Each prop In properties
    value = obj.GetROProperty(prop)
    Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Debug", prop & " = " & value
Next

' 4. Test with Object Spy during debug
' Tools → Object Spy while test paused
' Verify current object properties

' 5. Enable verbose logging
Setting.WebPackage("ReplayTimeout") = 10
Reporter.Filters = rfEnableAll

' 6. Check repository search path
For i = 1 to RepositoriesCollection.Count
    MsgBox i & ": " & RepositoriesCollection.Item(i).Path
Next
```

content.title: Object Repository Best Practices
content.explanation:
**Proven Strategies for Success:**

**1. Naming Conventions**

```vbscript
' Consistent naming patterns

Object Prefixes:
├── btn: Button (btnLogin, btnSubmit)
├── txt: Text field (txtUsername, txtPassword)
├── lbl: Label (lblError, lblTitle)
├── lnk: Link (lnkForgot, lnkRegister)
├── chk: Checkbox (chkRemember, chkAgree)
├── rad: Radio button (radGender, radOption)
├── lst: List (lstCountry, lstState)
├── img: Image (imgLogo, imgProfile)
├── tbl: Table (tblResults, tblData)
├── div: Div (divContainer, divContent)
├── frm: Frame/Form (frmLogin, frmSearch)
└── dlg: Dialog (dlgConfirm, dlgAlert)

Page/Module Naming:
├── LoginPage (top-level page)
├── DashboardPage
├── CheckoutModule
└── ReportsSection
```

**2. Repository Structure**

```
Recommended Organization:

Function SafeClick(objectPath)

**4. Repository Comparison Tool**

```vbscript
' Compare two repositories

Function CompareRepositories(repo1Path, repo2Path)
    Set repo1 = RepositoriesCollection.Open(repo1Path)
    Set repo2 = RepositoriesCollection.Open(repo2Path)
    
    ' Get all objects
    Set objects1 = repo1.GetAllObjects()
    Set objects2 = repo2.GetAllObjects()
    
    ' Find differences
    For Each obj1 In objects1
        found = False
        For Each obj2 In objects2
            If obj1.Name = obj2.Name Then
                found = True
                ' Compare properties
                If Not CompareProperties(obj1, obj2) Then
                    Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Compare", _
                        "Property mismatch: " & obj1.Name
                End If
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
        If Not found Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Compare", _
                "Object only in repo1: " & obj1.Name
        End If
    Next
End Function
```

content.title: What is Keyword-Driven Testing?
content.explanation:
**The Power of Abstraction:**

Keyword-driven testing is an approach where test cases are created using a set of predefined keywords that represent actions or operations on the application under test.

**The Concept:**

```
Traditional Test:              Keyword-Driven Test:
Browser("App").Page("Login").  | Item: LoginPage
    WebEdit("user").Set "john"  | Keyword: EnterText
                                | Value: john
Browser("App").Page("Login").  | Item: LoginPage
    WebEdit("pass").Set "123"   | Keyword: EnterText
                                | Value: 123
Browser("App").Page("Login").  | Item: LoginPage
    WebButton("login").Click    | Keyword: Click
                                | Value: Login Button
```

**Keyword-Driven Architecture:**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Keyword-Driven Framework                    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐          │
│  │   Test Data  │→ │   Keywords   │→ │    Object    │          │
│  │  (Excel/DB)  │  │   (Actions)  │  │ Repository   │          │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘          │
│         │               │               │                        │
│         ▼               ▼               ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                 Keyword Engine                             │   │
│  │  - Parses keywords                                         │   │
│  │  - Maps to functions                                       │   │
│  │  - Executes actions                                        │   │
│  │  - Handles data                                            │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                         │                                        │
│                         ▼                                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                 Application Under Test                     │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Keyword Test Structure:**

| Test Step | Item/Page | Keyword | Parameter 1 | Parameter 2 | Expected Result |
|-----------|-----------|---------|-------------|-------------|-----------------|
| 1 | LoginPage | NavigateTo | https://app.com | | Page Loaded |
| 2 | LoginPage | EnterText | username | john | |
| 3 | LoginPage | EnterText | password | secret | |
| 4 | LoginPage | Click | loginBtn | | HomePage Visible |

**Why Keyword-Driven Testing?**

| Benefit | Description | Impact |
|---------|-------------|--------|
| **Abstraction** | Separates test logic from implementation | Easier maintenance |
| **Reusability** | Keywords used across multiple tests | 60% less code |
| **Non-technical** | Business users can create tests | Wider collaboration |
| **Maintainability** | Change in one place | 70% faster updates |
| **Readability** | Tests read like business scenarios | Clearer documentation |
| **Scalability** | Easy to add new keywords | Framework grows gracefully |

**Keyword-Driven vs Other Approaches:**

```
Approach Comparison:

Linear Scripting:
├── Simple but brittle
├── Hard to maintain
└── Technical expertise needed

Data-Driven:
├── Separates test data
├── Reuses test logic
└── Good for multiple data sets

Keyword-Driven:
├── Separates actions
├── Maximum reusability
├── Non-technical friendly
└── Best for enterprise

Hybrid (Keyword + Data):
├── Combines both approaches
├── Most powerful
└── Industry standard
```

content.title: Mastering UFT's Keyword View
content.explanation:
**The Visual Test Creation Interface:**

UFT's Keyword View provides a table-based interface for creating and managing tests without writing code.

**Keyword View Interface:**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Keyword View - Test: LoginTest                                   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Item           │ Operation      │ Value         │ Documentation │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Browser        │ Navigate       │ about:blank   │ Start browser  │
│ Google         │ Navigate       │ google.com    │ Go to Google   │
│ Page: Google   │                │               │                │
│ ├─WebEdit: q   │ Set            │ UFT tutorial  │ Enter search   │
│ ├─WebButton    │ Click          │               │ Click search   │
│ └─Page         │ Sync           │               │ Wait for page  │
│ Browser        │ Close          │               │ Close browser  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Keyword View Columns:**

| Column | Description | Example |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| **Item** | Object hierarchy and name | Browser("Google").Page("Search") |
| **Operation** | Action to perform | Click, Set, Select, Navigate |
| **Value** | Parameter for the operation | "username", "submit" |
| **Documentation** | Description of step | "Enter username" |
| **Assignment** | Store result in variable | Set varName = value |
| **Comment** | Optional comment | ' Login step |

**Keyword View Operations:**

```vbscript
' Common operations available:

Navigation:
├── Navigate (URL navigation)
├── Back (browser back)
├── Forward (browser forward)
├── Refresh (page refresh)
├── Sync (wait for page load)

Element Actions:
├── Click (click element)
├── Set (set text value)
├── Select (choose from list)
├── Check (verify checkpoint)
├── Highlight (visual highlight)
├── Drag (drag element)
├── Drop (drop element)

Validation:
├── CheckProperty (verify property)
├── Exist (check existence)
├── WaitProperty (wait for property)

Utility:
├── RunAction (call another action)
├── RunScript (execute script)
├── Comment (add comment)
├── Output (capture value)
```

**Using Keyword View:**

```vbscript
' Method 1: Record and generate
1. Click Record button
2. Perform actions in application
3. Stop recording
4. View generated keywords in table

' Method 2: Manual entry
1. Right-click in Keyword View
2. Insert Step
3. Select object from repository
4. Choose operation
5. Enter value if needed

' Method 3: Drag and drop
1. Open Object Repository
2. Drag object into Keyword View
3. Select operation from context menu
4. Configure parameters
```

**Switching Between Views:**

```vbscript
' Keyword View ↔ Expert View

Keyword View (Table-based):
✓ Non-technical users
✓ Visual representation
✓ Easy to modify
✓ Auto-formatting
✓ Less error-prone

Expert View (Code-based):
✓ Technical users
✓ Full programming control
✓ Complex logic
✓ Variables and loops
✓ Error handling

Toggle: View → Expert View / Keyword View
Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+K
```

**Keyword View Best Practices:**

```
✅ DO:
- Use descriptive object names
- Add documentation for complex steps
- Group related steps together
- Use comments for clarity
- Keep steps atomic

❌ DON'T:
- Mix too many objects in one step
- Skip documentation
- Create overly long tests
- Use generic step names
- Ignore error conditions
```

steps.action: Plan the test in business terms
details:
**Test Scenario Design:**

```
Scenario: User Login and Purchase

Business Flow:
1. Open application
2. Login with credentials
3. Search for product
4. Add to cart
5. Checkout
6. Verify order

Keyword Test Structure:
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step │ Keyword        │ Data        │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1    │ Navigate       │ app.com     │
│ 2    │ EnterUsername  │ user123     │
│ 3    │ EnterPassword  │ pass123     │
│ 4    │ ClickLogin     │             │
│ 5    │ SearchProduct  │ laptop      │
│ 6    │ AddToCart      │ first result│
│ 7    │ Checkout       │             │
│ 8    │ VerifyOrder    │ confirmation│
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Keyword Implementation:**

```vbscript
' Keywords.vbs - Library of reusable keywords

' Navigation keyword
Function NavigateTo(url)
    Browser("App").Navigate url
    Browser("App").Page("App").Sync
    NavigateTo = True
End Function

' Login keyword
Function Login(username, password)
    Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set username
    Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("password").SetSecure password
    Browser("App").Page("Login").WebButton("login").Click
    
    ' Verify login success
    If Browser("App").Page("Dashboard").Exist(10) Then
        Login = True
        Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Login", "Success for: " & username
    Else
        Login = False
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Failed for: " & username
    End If
End Function

' Search keyword
Function SearchProduct(product)
    Browser("App").Page("Home").WebEdit("search").Set product
    Browser("App").Page("Home").WebButton("searchBtn").Click
    
    ' Wait for results
    SearchProduct = Browser("App").Page("Results").WebElement("results").Exist(10)
End Function

' Click keyword
Function ClickObject(objectPath)
    On Error Resume Next
    Set obj = Eval(objectPath)
    If obj.Exist(5) Then
        obj.Click
        ClickObject = True
    Else
        ClickObject = False
    End If
End Function
```

**Test Data Structure:**

```vbscript
' Excel Test Data Format
' Sheet: LoginTests

| TestID | Username | Password | Product | Expected |
|--------|----------|----------|---------|----------|
| TC01   | user1    | pass1    | laptop  | Success  |
| TC02   | user2    | pass2    | mouse   | Success  |
| TC03   | user3    | pass3    | keyboard| Success  |

' Data Table in UFT
DataTable.ImportSheet "C:\TestData.xls", "LoginTests", "Global"

' Loop through test data
rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount
For i = 1 to rowCount
    username = DataTable.Value("Username", "Global")
    password = DataTable.Value("Password", "Global")
    product = DataTable.Value("Product", "Global")
    
    ' Execute keywords
    NavigateTo("http://app.com")
    Login(username, password)
    SearchProduct(product)
    AddToCart()
    
    DataTable.SetNextRow
Next
```

**Keyword Driver Script:**

```vbscript
' KeywordDriver.vbs - Main execution engine

Sub ExecuteKeywordTest(testSheet)
    ' Get test steps
    stepCount = DataTable.GetSheet(testSheet).GetRowCount
    
    For step = 1 to stepCount
        ' Read keyword test row
        item = DataTable.Value("Item", testSheet)
        keyword = DataTable.Value("Keyword", testSheet)
        param1 = DataTable.Value("Param1", testSheet)
        param2 = DataTable.Value("Param2", testSheet)
        
        ' Execute based on keyword
        Select Case UCase(keyword)
            Case "NAVIGATE"
                Call NavigateTo(param1)
            
            Case "LOGIN"
                Call Login(param1, param2)
            
            Case "CLICK"
                Call ClickObject(item & "." & param1)
            
            Case "SET"
                SetObjectValue item, param1, param2
            
            Case "VERIFY"
                Call VerifyObject(item, param1, param2)
            
            Case "WAIT"
                Wait param1
            
            Case Else
                Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Driver", _
                    "Unknown keyword: " & keyword
        End Select
        
        ' Check for failure
        If Reporter.RunStatus = micFail Then
            Exit For
        End If
        
        DataTable.SetNextRow
    Next
End Sub

' Helper function for setting values
Sub SetObjectValue(objectPath, element, value)
    On Error Resume Next
    Set obj = Eval(objectPath & "." & element)
    If Not obj Is Nothing Then
        obj.Set value
    End If
End Sub

' Execute the test
ExecuteKeywordTest "TestSteps"
```

**Keyword Test Template:**

```vbscript
' Excel Sheet: Test_Login

| Step | Item          | Keyword | Param1        | Param2    | Expected        |
|------|---------------|---------|---------------|-----------|-----------------|
| 1    | Browser       | Navigate| http://app.com|           | Page Loaded     |
| 2    | LoginPage     | Verify  | title         | Login     | Page visible    |
| 3    | LoginPage     | Set     | username      | user1     |                 |
| 4    | LoginPage     | Set     | password      | pass1     |                 |
| 5    | LoginPage     | Click   | loginButton   |           |                 |
| 6    | Dashboard     | Verify  | welcome       | Welcome   | Dashboard shows |
| 7    | Dashboard     | Click   | logoutButton  |           |                 |
| 8    | LoginPage     | Verify  | title         | Login     | Back to login   |

' Multiple test cases in same sheet
| TestCase | Step | Item    | Keyword | Param1 |
|----------|------|---------|---------|--------|
| TC01     | 1    | Browser | Navigate| app.com|
| TC01     | 2    | Login   | Login   | user1  |
| TC02     | 1    | Browser | Navigate| app.com|
| TC02     | 2    | Login   | Login   | user2  |
```

**Keyword Error Handling:**

```vbscript
' Enhanced keyword execution with error handling

Function SafeExecuteKeyword(keyword, params)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' Log start
    Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Keyword", _
        "Executing: " & keyword & " with params: " & params
    
    ' Execute with timeout
    startTime = Timer
    timeout = 30 ' seconds
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        result = ExecuteKeyword(keyword, params)
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            ' Success
            SafeExecuteKeyword = result
            Exit Function
        Else
            ' Log error and retry
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Keyword", _
                "Attempt failed: " & Err.Description & ". Retrying..."
            Err.Clear
            Wait 2
        End If
    Loop
    
    ' Timeout occurred
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Keyword", _
        "Keyword execution timed out after " & timeout & " seconds"
    SafeExecuteKeyword = False
End Function

' Recovery scenario for keywords
Function ExecuteWithRecovery(keyword, params)
    ' Try normal execution
    If Not SafeExecuteKeyword(keyword, params) Then
        ' Execute recovery
        TakeScreenshot
        LogFailure keyword, params
        
        ' Attempt recovery action
        If RecoverApplication() Then
            ' Retry once
            ExecuteWithRecovery = SafeExecuteKeyword(keyword, params)
        Else
            ExecuteWithRecovery = False
        End If
    Else
        ExecuteWithRecovery = True
    End If
End Function
```

content.title: Building an Enterprise Keyword Framework
content.explanation:
**Taking Keywords to Production:** **1. Keyword Hierarchy** ```vbscript ' Multi-level keyword architecture Level 1: Atomic Keywords (Basic operations) ├── Click ├── SetText ├── SelectItem ├── GetText └── WaitForElement Level 2: Business Keywords (Domain-specific) ├── Login ├── AddToCart ├── Checkout ├── SearchProduct └── CreateOrder Level 3: Composite Keywords (Complex flows) ├── PurchaseProduct (Login + Search + Add + Checkout) ├── UserRegistration (FillForm + Submit + Verify) └── OrderCancellation (FindOrder + Cancel + Confirm) Level 4: Scenario Keywords (End-to-end) ├── NewUserPurchase ├── ExistingUserReorder └── GuestCheckout ``` **2. Parameterized Keywords** ```vbscript ' Keywords with flexible parameters ' With optional parameters Function Login(Optional username, Optional password, Optional rememberMe = False) If IsEmpty(username) Then username = Environment.Value("DefaultUser") If IsEmpty(password) Then password = Environment.Value("DefaultPass") ' Login logic Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set username Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("password").SetSecure password If rememberMe Then Browser("App").Page("Login").WebCheckBox("remember").Set "ON" End If Browser("App").Page("Login").WebButton("login").Click End Function ' Usage Call Login() ' Uses defaults Call Login("admin", "pass") ' Specified credentials Call Login(rememberMe:=True) ' Remember me checked ``` **3. Keyword Result Handling** ```vbscript ' Keywords returning structured results Type KeywordResult Status As Boolean Message As String Data As Object ScreenshotPath As String ExecutionTime As Long End Type Function ExecuteKeyword(keyword, params) As KeywordResult Dim result As KeywordResult Dim startTime startTime = Timer On Error Resume Next ' Execute keyword Select Case keyword Case "Login" result.Status = Login(params(0), params(1)) If result.Status Then result.Message = "Login successful" result.Data = GetUserInfo() Else result.Message = "Login failed" End If End Select ' Capture results If Err.Number <> 0 Then result.Status = False result.Message = Err.Description result.ScreenshotPath = TakeScreenshot() End If result.ExecutionTime = Timer - startTime ExecuteKeyword = result End Function ' Using keyword results Set res = ExecuteKeyword("Login", Array("user", "pass")) If res.Status Then Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Login", _ res.Message & " (" & res.ExecutionTime & "ms)" Else Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", _ res.Message & " - Screenshot: " & res.ScreenshotPath End If ``` **4. Keyword Data Provider** ```vbscript ' Centralized keyword data management Class KeywordDataProvider Private testData Private currentRow Private Sub Class_Initialize() Set testData = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") LoadTestData End Sub Private Sub LoadTestData() ' Load from Excel Dim excel, sheet Set excel = CreateObject("Excel.Application") excel.Workbooks.Open "C:\TestData.xlsx" ' Read keyword test data Set sheet = excel.ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("Keywords") row = 2 ' Skip header Do While sheet.Cells(row, 1).Value <> "" Dim testId testId = sheet.Cells(row, 1).Value If Not testData.Exists(testId) Then Set testData(testId) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End If ' Store step stepNum = sheet.Cells(row, 2).Value Set testData(testId)(stepNum) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") testData(testId)(stepNum)("Keyword") = sheet.Cells(row, 3).Value testData(testId)(stepNum)("Params") = Split(sheet.Cells(row, 4).Value, "|") row = row + 1 Loop excel.Quit End Sub Function GetTestSteps(testId) If testData.Exists(testId) Then Set GetTestSteps = testData(testId) Else Set GetTestSteps = Nothing End If End Function End Class ``` **5. Keyword Performance Monitoring** ```vbscript ' Track keyword execution metrics Class KeywordMetrics Private metrics Private Sub Class_Initialize() Set metrics = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End Sub Sub LogKeyword(keyword, duration, status) If Not metrics.Exists(keyword) Then Set metrics(keyword) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") metrics(keyword)("count") = 0 metrics(keyword)("totalTime") = 0 metrics(keyword)("failures") = 0 End If metrics(keyword)("count") = metrics(keyword)("count") + 1 metrics(keyword)("totalTime") = metrics(keyword)("totalTime") + duration If Not status Then metrics(keyword)("failures") = metrics(keyword)("failures") + 1 End If End Sub Function GetReport() Dim report report = "Keyword Performance Report" & vbNewLine report = report & String(50, "=") & vbNewLine For Each keyword In metrics.Keys avgTime = metrics(keyword)("totalTime") / metrics(keyword)("count") failRate = (metrics(keyword)("failures") / metrics(keyword)("count")) * 100 report = report & keyword & vbNewLine report = report & " Calls: " & metrics(keyword)("count") & vbNewLine report = report & " Avg Time: " & Round(avgTime, 2) & "ms" & vbNewLine report = report & " Fail Rate: " & Round(failRate, 2) & "%" & vbNewLine Next GetReport = report End Function End Class ``` **6. Keyword Documentation Generator** ```vbscript ' Auto-generate keyword documentation Sub GenerateKeywordDocs() Dim fso, file Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") Set file = fso.CreateTextFile("KeywordLibrary.html", True) ' HTML header file.WriteLine "Keyword Library" file.WriteLine "" file.WriteLine "" file.WriteLine "

Keyword-Driven Test Library" file.WriteLine "KeywordDescriptionParametersExampleReturns" ' Add each keyword file.WriteLine "" file.WriteLine "Login" file.WriteLine "Authenticate user with credentials" file.WriteLine "username (string), password (string), rememberMe (boolean)" file.WriteLine "Login('admin', 'pass', true)" file.WriteLine "Boolean" file.WriteLine "" file.WriteLine "" file.WriteLine "" file.Close MsgBox "Documentation generated: KeywordLibrary.html" End Sub ```

content.title: Keyword-Driven Testing Best Practices
content.explanation:
**Proven Strategies for Success:**

**1. Keyword Design Principles**

```
✅ DO:
- Keep keywords atomic (single responsibility)
- Use descriptive names (Login, not Lgn)
- Make parameters intuitive
- Return status/results
- Document each keyword
- Handle errors gracefully

❌ DON'T:
- Create monolithic keywords
- Use cryptic abbreviations
- Hardcode values in keywords
- Ignore error conditions
- Mix UI and business logic
- Duplicate functionality

Keyword Examples:
Good: Login(username, password)
Bad: ProcessUser(user, pass, doLogin, doSearch, doLogout)

Good: ClickButton(buttonName)
Bad: Click(buttonName, waitTime, retryCount, verifyResult)
```

**2. Test Design Patterns**

```vbscript
' Pattern 1: Action-Object-Data
' Keyword: Click
' Object: LoginButton
' Data: (none)
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebButton("LoginButton").Click

' Pattern 2: Business Process
' Keyword: PurchaseItem
' Parameters: product, quantity, paymentMethod
Call PurchaseItem("Laptop", 1, "CreditCard")

' Pattern 3: Verification
' Keyword: VerifyText
' Parameters: object, expected, timeout
If VerifyText("WelcomeMessage", "Hello John", 5) Then
    ' Test passes
End If

' Pattern 4: Data-Driven
' Keyword: ProcessTestRow
' Uses data from Excel row
Call ProcessTestRow(DataTable.Value("TestCase", dtGlobalSheet))
```

**3. Keyword Organization**

```
Keyword Library Structure:

Function Libraries/
├── Core/
│   ├── Navigation.vbs (Navigate, Back, Refresh)
│   ├── Input.vbs (Set, Select, Check)
│   ├── Verification.vbs (Verify, WaitFor, Assert)
│   └── Utility.vbs (Wait, Log, Screenshot)
├── Business/
│   ├── Login.vbs (Login, Logout, ChangePassword)
│   ├── Shopping.vbs (Search, AddToCart, Checkout)
│   ├── Account.vbs (Register, UpdateProfile)
│   └── Reports.vbs (GenerateReport, ExportData)
└── Application/
    ├── Module1.vbs (application-specific flows)
    └── Module2.vbs (more specific flows)
```

**4. Complete Example: E-Commerce Test**

```vbscript
' ===========================================
' E-Commerce Keyword Test Example
' ===========================================

' Test Data (Excel)
| TestID | Product | Quantity | Payment | Expected |
|--------|---------|----------|---------|----------|
| TC01   | Laptop  | 1        | CC      | Success  |
| TC02   | Mouse   | 2        | PP      | Success  |

' Keywords Library
' ------------------

' Navigation keyword
Function NavigateTo(url)
    Browser("App").Navigate url
    NavigateTo = Browser("App").Page("App").Sync
End Function

' Login keyword
Function Login(user, pass)
    With Browser("App").Page("Login")
        .WebEdit("username").Set user
        .WebEdit("password").SetSecure pass
        .WebButton("loginBtn").Click
    End With
    
    Login = Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(10)
End Function

' Search keyword
Function SearchProduct(product)
    With Browser("App").Page("Home")
        .WebEdit("search").Set product
        .WebButton("searchBtn").Click
    End With
    
    SearchProduct = Browser("App").Page("Results") _
        .WebElement("productList").Exist(5)
End Function

' Add to cart keyword
Function AddToCart(productIndex)
    productLink = "product_" & productIndex
    Browser("App").Page("Results").Link(productLink).Click
    Browser("App").Page("Product").WebButton("addToCart").Click
    
    ' Verify cart update
    cartCount = Browser("App").Page("Header") _
        .WebElement("cartCount").GetROProperty("innertext")
    AddToCart = CInt(cartCount) > 0
End Function

' Checkout keyword
Function Checkout(paymentMethod)
    Browser("App").Page("Cart").WebButton("checkout").Click
    
    With Browser("App").Page("Checkout")
        .WebList("payment").Select paymentMethod
        .WebButton("placeOrder").Click
    End With
    
    Checkout = Browser("App").Page("Confirmation") _
        .WebElement("orderNumber").Exist(10)
End Function

' Main test execution
' ------------------
rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount

For i = 1 to rowCount
    product = DataTable.Value("Product", dtGlobalSheet)
    quantity = DataTable.Value("Quantity", dtGlobalSheet)
    payment = DataTable.Value("Payment", dtGlobalSheet)
    
    ' Execute test flow using keywords
    If Not NavigateTo("http://shop.com") Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Test", "Navigation failed"
        GoTo NextIteration
    End If
    
    If Not Login("testuser", "password") Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Test", "Login failed"
        GoTo NextIteration
    End If
    
    If Not SearchProduct(product) Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Test", "Search failed"
        GoTo NextIteration
    End If
    
    For j = 1 to quantity
        If Not AddToCart(j) Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Test", _
                "Add to cart failed for item " & j
            GoTo NextIteration
        End If
    Next
    
    If Not Checkout(payment) Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Test", "Checkout failed"
        GoTo NextIteration
    End If
    
    Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Test", _
        "Test passed for product: " & product
    
NextIteration:
    DataTable.SetNextRow
Next
```

**5. Common Keyword Patterns**

| Pattern | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| **Action** | Perform an operation | Click, Set, Select |
| **Verification** | Check expected result | VerifyText, AssertExist |
| **Navigation** | Move between pages | GoToPage, Back, Refresh |
| **Data Operation** | Handle test data | GetData, StoreData |
| **Wait Operation** | Synchronization | WaitForElement, WaitForPage |
| **Utility** | Helper functions | TakeScreenshot, LogMessage |
| **Composite** | Combine multiple steps | Login, Checkout, Register |
| **Conditional** | Decision making | IfElementExists, RetryUntil |

**6. Framework Evaluation Checklist**

```
✅ Keyword Framework Assessment:

Design:
□ Keywords are atomic and reusable
□ Clear naming conventions
□ Consistent parameter structure
□ Return meaningful results
□ Error handling implemented

Coverage:
□ All UI actions covered
□ Business processes captured
□ Verification keywords exist
□ Utility functions available

Maintainability:
□ Keywords are documented
□ No duplication
□ Easy to add new keywords
□ Version controlled
□ Change impact minimal

Performance:
□ Keywords execute efficiently
□ No unnecessary waits
□ Resource usage optimized
□ Parallel execution ready

Usability:
□ Non-technical can understand
□ Test data separated
□ Clear documentation
□ Examples provided
□ Training materials available
```

**7. ROI of Keyword-Driven Testing**

```
Investment:
├── Framework design: 2-4 weeks
├── Keyword development: 1-2 weeks
├── Team training: 2-3 days
└── Initial test creation: 1 week

Returns:
├── Test creation speed: ↑ 60%
├── Test maintenance: ↓ 70%
├── Test reuse: ↑ 80%
├── Onboarding time: ↓ 50%
└── Business user involvement: ↑ Yes

Break-even: 3-4 months
Annual savings: 500+ person-hours
```

content.title: Hybrid Testing Frameworks
content.explanation:
**Combining Keywords with Other Methods:**

**1. Keyword + Data-Driven**

```vbscript
' Hybrid: Keywords with external data

' Excel Data: TestCases.xlsx
| TestID | Keyword   | Param1 | Param2 | DataSource |
|--------|-----------|--------|--------|------------|
| TC01   | Login     | User1  | Pass1  | UsersDB    |
| TC01   | Search    |        |        | Products   |
| TC01   | Purchase  |        |        | Orders     |

' Execute with data
Function ExecuteHybridTest(testId)
    ' Get test steps
    Set steps = GetTestSteps(testId)
    
    For Each step In steps
        keyword = step.Keyword
        
        ' If keyword needs data, fetch from source
        If step.DataSource <> "" Then
            Set data = GetTestData(step.DataSource)
            ' Execute keyword with data
            ExecuteKeyword keyword, data
        Else
            ' Execute with direct params
            ExecuteKeyword keyword, Array(step.Param1, step.Param2)
        End If
    Next
End Function
```

**2. Keyword + BPT (Business Process Testing)**

```vbscript
' UFT BPT integration

' Create business components
Component: Login
├── Input: Username, Password
├── Keyword Steps:
│   ├── NavigateToLogin
│   ├── EnterUsername
│   ├── EnterPassword
│   └── ClickLogin
└── Output: LoginStatus

Component: Search
├── Input: SearchTerm
├── Keyword Steps:
│   ├── EnterSearchTerm
│   ├── ClickSearch
│   └── VerifyResults
└── Output: ResultsCount

' Business process test
Business Process: Purchase
├── Component: Login (user1, pass1)
├── Component: Search (laptop)
├── Component: AddToCart (first)
├── Component: Checkout (credit)
└── Component: VerifyOrder
```

**3. Keyword + Behavior-Driven**

```vbscript
' Gherkin-style keywords

Feature: Purchase
  Scenario: User buys product
    Given I am on the login page
    When I login with "user" and "pass"
    Then I should see the home page
    When I search for "laptop"
    Then search results should appear

' Keyword implementation
Function Given_I_am_on_the_login_page()
    NavigateTo("http://app.com/login")
End Function

Function When_I_login_with(user, pass)
    Login(user, pass)
End Function

Function Then_I_should_see_the_home_page()
    Assert Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(5)
End Function
```

**4. Framework Comparison**

| Aspect | Keyword | Data-Driven | BPT | Hybrid |
|--------|---------|-------------|-----|--------|
| **Abstraction** | High | Medium | High | Very High |
| **Reusability** | High | Medium | High | Very High |
| **Technical Skill** | Low-Medium | Medium | Low | Medium |
| **Data Handling** | Medium | High | Medium | High |
| **Maintenance** | Easy | Medium | Easy | Easy |
| **Setup Time** | Medium | Low | High | High |
| **Best For** | Enterprise | Data variations | Business teams | Complex apps |

**5. Implementation Strategy**

```
Phased Hybrid Framework Adoption:

Phase 1: Foundation (Week 1-2)
├── Set up basic keywords
├── Create object repository
├── Build simple driver
└── Create first test

Phase 2: Data Integration (Week 3-4)
├── Connect to test data
├── Parameterize keywords
├── Add data-driven capabilities
└── Expand test coverage

Phase 3: Advanced Features (Week 5-6)
├── Add error handling
├── Implement reporting
├── Create recovery scenarios
└── Optimize performance

Phase 4: Enterprise Ready (Week 7-8)
├── Version control
├── CI/CD integration
├── Team training
└── Documentation
```

content.title: What is Application Lifecycle Management?
content.explanation:
**The Enterprise Testing Hub:**

Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), formerly known as Quality Center, is Micro Focus's comprehensive platform for managing the entire application lifecycle from requirements to deployment.

**ALM Architecture:**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        ALM Platform                              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐          │
│  │ Requirements │  │   Test Plan  │  │  Test Lab    │          │
│  │  Management  │  │  Management  │  │  Management  │          │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘          │
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐          │
│  │   Defect     │  │   Release    │  │  Dashboard   │          │
│  │  Tracking    │  │  Management  │  │  & Reports   │          │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘          │
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                    Integration Layer                       │   │
│  │  UFT │ Jenkins │ Git │ JIRA │ ServiceNow │ Other Tools    │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Key ALM Modules:**

| Module | Purpose | Key Features |
|--------|---------|--------------|
| **Requirements** | Manage test requirements | Traceability, coverage analysis |
| **Test Plan** | Create and organize tests | Test design, parameterization |
| **Test Lab** | Execute test sets | Scheduling, execution grids |
| **Defects** | Track issues | Lifecycle, attachments, workflow |
| **Dashboard** | Monitor progress | Reports, metrics, KPIs |
| **Library** | Reusable assets | Shared objects, templates |

**Why ALM for Test Management:**

```
Benefits of Centralized Test Management:

1. Traceability
   ├── Requirements → Tests → Defects
   ├── Impact analysis
   └── Compliance reporting

2. Collaboration
   ├── Team access control
   ├── Shared resources
   └── Workflow automation

3. Governance
   ├── Audit trails
   ├── Version control
   └── Approval processes

4. Reporting
   ├── Real-time dashboards
   ├── Custom reports
   └── Trend analysis

5. Integration
   ├── UFT automation
   ├── CI/CD tools
   └── Third-party systems
```

**ALM in the Testing Ecosystem:**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       ALM - Central Hub                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                  │
│  Requirements ←───────────→ Tests ←───────────→ Defects         │
│       ↑                           ↑                  ↑          │
│       │                           │                  │          │
│  Business                     UFT Tests           Developers    │
│  Analysts                        │                  │          │
│                                  ↓                  ↓          │
│                            Execution            Fixes           │
│                            Results               │              │
│                                  ↓                  ↓          │
│                            Reports ←────────── Verification    │
│                                                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**5. ROI Analysis**

**6. Key Integration Capabilities**

```vbscript
' What you can do with integration

' 1. Open tests from ALM
ALM.LaunchTest "Subject\Login\TC001"

' 2. Run tests in ALM context
Set tdc = CreateObject("TDAPIOLE80.TDConnection")
tdc.InitConnectionEx "http://almserver:8080/qcbin"
tdc.Login "username", "password"
tdc.Connect "Project_Domain", "Project_Name"

' 3. Update test results
QCUtil.CurrentTestSet.Test("TC001").SetStatus "Passed"

' 4. Create defects automatically
If testFailed Then
    Set defect = QCUtil.CurrentTestSet.DefectFactory.AddItem(Null)
    defect.Field("BG_DESCRIPTION") = "Test failed: " & errorMsg
    defect.Field("BG_STATUS") = "New"
    defect.Post
End If
```

steps.action: Set up ALM connection in UFT
details:
**Installation Steps:**

```
1. Close UFT if running

2. Navigate to ALM server:
   http://almserver:8080/qcbin

3. Download ALM Client-Side Add-in:
   - Click 'Add-Ins Page'
   - Select 'UFT Add-in'
   - Download installer

4. Run installer:
   - ALM_Connectivity_UFT.exe
   - Accept license
   - Select installation directory
   - Complete installation

5. Verify installation:
   - Check Add/Remove Programs
   - Look for 'ALM Connectivity for UFT'
   - Version matches ALM server

Alternative: Install from UFT setup
- Run UFT installer
- Select 'Custom Installation'
- Check 'ALM Connectivity'
- Complete installation
```

**UFT Configuration:**

```vbscript
' Method 1: UI Configuration
1. Open UFT
2. Tools → Options → ALM
3. Check 'Enable ALM Connectivity'
4. Set ALM Server URL:
   http://almserver:8080/qcbin
5. Set timeout (default: 300 seconds)
6. Configure proxy if needed
7. Click OK

' Method 2: Registry Configuration
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Micro Focus\UFT\ALM]
"ServerURL"="http://almserver:8080/qcbin"
"Timeout"=dword:0000012c
"EnableSSL"=dword:00000000

' Method 3: Command Line
UFT.exe -alm_server http://almserver:8080/qcbin -alm_user username -alm_password password
```

**Connection Steps:**

```vbscript
' From UFT UI
1. File → ALM → Login
2. Enter credentials
3. Select Domain and Project
4. Click Connect

' Programmatic connection
Set almConnection = CreateObject("TDAPIOLE80.TDConnection")
almConnection.InitConnectionEx "http://almserver:8080/qcbin"
almConnection.Login "username", "password"
almConnection.Connect "DEFAULT", "MyProject"

If almConnection.Connected Then
    MsgBox "Connected to: " & almConnection.ProjectName
Else
    MsgBox "Connection failed"
End If

' Check connection status
Function IsALMConnected()
    On Error Resume Next
    IsALMConnected = QCUtil.IsConnected
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        IsALMConnected = False
    End If
End Function
```

**ALM Project Structure:**

```
Project: E-Commerce
├── Subject (Test Plan Tree)
│   ├── Smoke Tests
│   │   ├── TC001_Login
│   │   ├── TC002_Search
│   │   └── TC003_Checkout
│   ├── Regression
│   │   ├── User Management
│   │   ├── Order Processing
│   │   └── Payment Gateway
│   └── API Tests
│       ├── REST Services

Parameter Passing Between ALM and UFT** ```vbscript ' In ALM test configuration ' Set parameters in ALM Test parameters: ├── Browser = Chrome ├── Environment = Staging ├── Username = {USERS:Admin} ├── Password = {ENV:ADMIN_PASS} └── RetryCount = 3 ' In UFT test ' Retrieve parameters from ALM browser = QCUtil.Parameter("Browser") env = QCUtil.Parameter("Environment") username = QCUtil.Parameter("Username") ' Use parameters NavigateTo "http://" & env & ".example.com" Login username, DecryptPassword("Password") ' Complex parameter passing ' ALM parameter: TestData = {TABLE:LoginData.xls} ' UFT code: testDataPath = QCUtil.Parameter("TestData") DataTable.Import testDataPath ``` **2. ALM Workflow Customization** ```vbscript ' ALM workflow scripts (VBScript) ' Test execution pre-run Sub Test_CanExecute(Test, IsAllowed) ' Check if test can run If Test.Field("TS_STATUS") = "Obsolete" Then IsAllowed = False MsgBox "Test is obsolete, cannot run" End If ' Check environment availability If Not IsEnvironmentAvailable() Then IsAllowed = False End If End Sub ' Test execution post-run Sub Test_AfterExecute(Test, Run) ' Update requirement coverage If Run.Field("RN_STATUS") = "Passed" Then UpdateRequirementCoverage Test End If ' Send notification If Run.Field("RN_STATUS") = "Failed" Then SendFailureNotification Test, Run End If End Sub ' Defect creation workflow Sub Defect_BeforePost(Defect) ' Auto-assign based on module module = GetModuleFromDefect(Defect) Defect.Field("BG_ASSIGNEE") = GetOwner(module) ' Set priority based on test If InStr(Defect.Field("BG_SUMMARY"), "Critical") > 0 Then Defect.Field("BG_PRIORITY") = "1-Urgent" End If End Sub ``` **3. Cross-Project Test Management** ```vbscript ' Share tests across projects ' Export test from Project A Set sourceTest = sourceTdc.TestFactory.Item(testID) sourceTest.ExportTest "C:\Temp\exported_test" ' Import to Project B Set targetTdc = CreateObject("TDAPIOLE80.TDConnection") targetTdc.InitConnectionEx almURL targetTdc.Login user, pass targetTdc.Connect "Domain", "ProjectB" Set testFactory = targetTdc.TestFactory Set newTest = testFactory.AddItem(Null) newTest.Field("TS_NAME") = sourceTest.Field("TS_NAME") newTest.Field("TS_TYPE") = "QUICKTEST_TEST" newTest.Post newTest.ImportTest "C:\Temp\exported_test", True ' Link to original for synchronization newTest.Field("TS_USER_01") = _ "Linked to ProjectA:Test:" & testID newTest.Post ``` **4. Integration with CI/CD** ```vbscript ' Jenkins integration ' Jenkins pipeline step stage('ALM Test Execution') { steps { script { // Trigger ALM test set def response = httpRequest( url: 'http://almserver:8080/qcbin/api/v2/test-sets/123/run', httpMode: 'POST', authentication: 'ALM_CREDENTIALS' ) // Wait for completion def runId = response.content waitForALMCompletion(runId) } } } ' ALM REST API Function TriggerTestSetViaAPI(testSetID) Set http = CreateObject("MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP") ' Authenticate http.Open "POST", almURL & "/api/authentication/sign-in", False http.SetRequestHeader "Content-Type", "application/json" http.Send "{\"username\":\"user\",\"password\":\"pass\"}" ' Get token token = http.getResponseHeader("LWSSO_COOKIE_KEY") ' Trigger test set http.Open "POST", almURL & "/api/v2/test-sets/" & testSetID & "/run", False http.SetRequestHeader "LWSSO_COOKIE_KEY", token http.Send TriggerTestSetViaAPI = http.responseText End Function ``` **5. Custom Reporting and Dashboards** ```vbscript ' Create custom ALM reports Function GenerateTestHealthReport(project) Set tdc = ConnectToALM(project) ' Get test data Set testFactory = tdc.TestFactory Set testFilter = testFactory.Filter testFilter.Field("TS_TYPE") = "QUICKTEST_TEST" Set testList = testFilter.NewList() ' Analyze test health totalTests = 0 passingTests = 0 failingTests = 0 notRunTests = 0 For each test in testList totalTests = totalTests + 1 lastRun = test.LastRun If lastRun Is Nothing Then notRunTests = notRunTests + 1 ElseIf lastRun.Field("RN_STATUS") = "Passed" Then passingTests = passingTests + 1 Else failingTests = failingTests + 1 End If Next ' Generate HTML report report = "" report = report & "

Test Health Report

" report = report & "

Total Tests: " & totalTests & "

" report = report & "

Passing: " & passingTests & "

" report = report & "

Failing: " & failingTests & "

" report = report & "

Not Run: " & notRunTests & "

" report = report & "" GenerateTestHealthReport = report End Function ```

content.title: Common Integration Issues and Solutions
content.explanation:
**Complete Troubleshooting Guide:**

**1. Connection Issues**

| Issue | Symptoms | Solution |
|-------|----------|----------|
| **Cannot connect to ALM** | Timeout, connection refused | Check server URL, port, network |
| **Authentication failed** | Invalid credentials | Verify username/password, check domain |
| **Project not accessible** | Project list empty | Check project permissions |
| **ALM add-in not loaded** | ALM options grayed out | Reinstall ALM connectivity add-in |

**Diagnostic Steps:**
```vbscript
' Test ALM connectivity
Function TestALMConnection()
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' Test 1: Basic URL access
    Set http = CreateObject("MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP")
    http.Open "GET", "http://almserver:8080/qcbin", False
    http.Send
    If http.Status <> 200 Then
        MsgBox "ALM server not accessible"
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Test 2: API access
    http.Open "GET", "http://almserver:8080/qcbin/rest/domains", False
    http.SetRequestHeader "Accept", "application/json"
    http.Send
    If http.Status = 401 Then
        MsgBox "Authentication required"
    ElseIf http.Status = 200 Then
        MsgBox "ALM is accessible"
    End If
End Function
```

**2. Test Upload/Download Issues**

```vbscript
' Fix test synchronization

Issue: Test won't upload
Check:
1. Test not checked out by another user
2. Sufficient disk space in ALM
3. Test name not duplicated
4. File permissions

Solution:
' Force check-in
Set test = tdc.TestFactory.Item(testID)
test.Locked = False

' Re-upload
If test.ImportTest(localPath, True) Then
    MsgBox "Upload successful"
Else
    ' Check error log
    errorLog = test.GetLastError()
End If
```

**3. Execution Failures**

```
Common Execution Errors:

Error: "UFT not installed on execution host"
Solution: Install UFT and ALM add-in

Error: "Test type not supported"
Solution: Check ALM test type (should be QUICKTEST_TEST)

Error: "Timeout waiting for UFT"
Solution: Increase timeout in ALM configuration

Error: "Cannot find object repository"
Solution: Ensure repositories are in ALM and paths correct
```

**4. Result Reporting Issues**

```vbscript
' Fix result publishing

Issue: Results not showing in ALM

Check:
1. Result storage location permissions
2. ALM result repository size
3. Network connectivity during upload

Function ForceResultUpload(testID, resultPath)
    Set test = tdc.TestFactory.Item(testID)
    Set run = test.RunFactory.AddItem(Null)
    run.Field("RN_STATUS") = "Passed"
    run.Field("RN_TESTER") = QCUtil.CurrentUser
    run.Field("RN_EXECUTION_DATE") = Now
    run.Post
    
    ' Attach result file
    run.Attachments.AddItem resultPath, True
    MsgBox "Results attached to run: " & run.ID
End Function
```

' ===========================================

' Author: Automation Engineer

' Main test flow
Sub TestMain()
    Dim username, password

        errorHandler(Err.Description)
        Try = False
        Err.Clear
    Else
        Try = True
    End If

Function RetryOperation(operation, maxRetries)
    Dim attempt

        operation()
        
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            RetryOperation = True
            Exit Function
        Else
            Wait 2 ' Wait before retry

    Next

```vbscript
' Track test results over time
Class TestTrendAnalyzer
    Private history
    
    Sub AddRun(testName, status, duration)
        Set run = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        run("date") = Now()
        run("status") = status
        run("duration") = duration
        
        If Not history.Exists(testName) Then
            Set history(testName) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        End If
        
        history(testName)(history(testName).Count + 1) = run
    End Sub
    
    Function GetStabilityScore(testName)
        Dim runs, passes, flakyCount
        Set runs = history(testName)
        
        passes = 0
        For i = 1 to runs.Count
            If runs(i)("status") = "Passed" Then
                passes = passes + 1
            End If
        Next
        
        ' Score based on pass rate and consistency
        passRate = passes / runs.Count * 100
        stability = CalculateConsistency(runs)
        
        GetStabilityScore = (passRate * 0.7) + (stability * 0.3)
    End Function
    
    Function IdentifyFlakyTests(threshold)
        Dim flakyTests
        Set flakyTests = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        For Each test In history.Keys
            score = GetStabilityScore(test)
            If score < threshold Then
                flakyTests.Add test, score
            End If
        Next
        
        Set IdentifyFlakyTests = flakyTests
    End Function
End Class

**4. Performance Profiling**

```vbscript
' Measure execution time
Class PerformanceProfiler
    Private startTimes
    Private metrics
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set startTimes = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        Set metrics = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Sub StartTimer(operationName)
        startTimes(operationName) = Timer
    End Sub
    
    Sub StopTimer(operationName)
        Dim duration
        duration = Timer - startTimes(operationName)
        
        If Not metrics.Exists(operationName) Then
            Set metrics(operationName) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            metrics(operationName)("count") = 0
            metrics(operationName)("totalTime") = 0
            metrics(operationName)("maxTime") = 0
        End If
        
        metrics(operationName)("count") = metrics(operationName)("count") + 1
        metrics(operationName)("totalTime") = metrics(operationName)("totalTime") + duration
        
        If duration > metrics(operationName)("maxTime") Then
            metrics(operationName)("maxTime") = duration
        End If
        
        If duration > 5 Then ' Warn if >5 seconds
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Performance", _
                operationName & " took " & Round(duration, 2) & " seconds"
        End If
    End Sub
    
    Function GetReport()
        Dim report
        report = "Performance Report" & vbNewLine
        report = report & String(50, "=") & vbNewLine
        
        For Each op In metrics.Keys
            avgTime = metrics(op)("totalTime") / metrics(op)("count")
            report = report & op & vbNewLine
            report = report & "  Calls: " & metrics(op)("count") & vbNewLine
            report = report & "  Avg Time: " & Round(avgTime, 2) & "s" & vbNewLine
            report = report & "  Max Time: " & Round(metrics(op)("maxTime"), 2) & "s" & vbNewLine
        Next
        
        GetReport = report
    End Function
End Class

' Test health checklist

Function AssessTestHealth(testPath)
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set test = fso.GetFolder(testPath)
    
    health = 100
    
    ' Check last modified
    daysSinceUpdate = DateDiff("d", test.DateLastModified, Now())
    If daysSinceUpdate > 30 Then
        health = health - 10
        AddIssue "Test not updated in " & daysSinceUpdate & " days"
    End If
    
    ' Check execution history
    results = CountResults(testPath)
    If results.total = 0 Then
        health = health - 20
        AddIssue "Test never executed"
    Else
        passRate = (results.passed / results.total) * 100
        If passRate < 80 Then
            health = health - 15
            AddIssue "Low pass rate: " & Round(passRate, 2) & "%"
        End If
    End If
    
    ' Check for errors
    errorCount = CountScriptErrors(testPath)
    If errorCount > 0 Then
        health = health - (errorCount * 5)
        AddIssue errorCount & " script errors found"
    End If
    
    AssessTestHealth = health
End Function

' Track improvement metrics
Class TestImprovementTracker
    Private metrics
    
    Sub RecordMetric(category, value)
        If Not metrics.Exists(category) Then
            Set metrics(category) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            metrics(category)("values") = Array()
        End If
        
        ' Add value to array
        values = metrics(category)("values")
        ReDim Preserve values(UBound(values) + 1)
        values(UBound(values)) = value
        metrics(category)("values") = values
    End Sub
    
    Function GetImprovement(category)
        values = metrics(category)("values")
        If UBound(values) < 1 Then
            GetImprovement = 0
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        ' Calculate trend
        first = values(0)
        last = values(UBound(values))
        GetImprovement = ((last - first) / first) * 100
    End Function
    
    Function GenerateReport()
        Dim report
        report = "Test Improvement Report" & vbNewLine
        report = report & String(50, "=") & vbNewLine
        
        For Each category In metrics.Keys
            improvement = GetImprovement(category)
            trend = "→"
            If improvement > 0 Then trend = "↑"
            If improvement < 0 Then trend = "↓"
            
            report = report & category & ": " & trend & " " & _
                     Abs(Round(improvement, 2)) & "%" & vbNewLine
        Next
        
        GenerateReport = report
    End Function
End Class
```
