content.title: The Synchronization Challenge in Test Automation
content.explanation:
**Why Tests Need to Wait:**

Synchronization in test automation refers to the coordination between test execution speed and application response time. When tests run faster than the application can respond, failures occur.

**The Synchronization Problem:**

```
Test Execution Timeline:

Test Step: Click Login Button
         ↓
[Application processing... 2 seconds]
         ↓
Test Step: Verify Welcome Message (immediate)
         ↓
❌ Failure: Welcome message not yet visible

With Synchronization:

Test Step: Click Login Button
         ↓
[Application processing... 2 seconds]
         ↓
Test Step: Wait for Welcome Message (max 10 seconds)
         ↓
[Welcome appears at 2 seconds]
         ↓
Test Step: Verify Welcome Message
         ↓
✅ Success: Welcome message verified
```

**Common Synchronization Scenarios:**

| Scenario | Issue | Impact |
|----------|-------|--------|
| **Page loads** | Page not fully loaded | Elements not available |
| **AJAX calls** | Dynamic content updates | Data not yet displayed |
| **Animations** | Elements moving/changing | Click targets wrong |
| **File uploads** | Processing time | Upload not complete |
| **Database ops** | Data propagation | Results not visible |
| **API responses** | Network latency | Response not received |
| **Modal dialogs** | Delayed appearance | Dialog not shown |

**The Cost of Poor Synchronization:**

```
Flaky Tests:
├── 40-60% of failures are timing-related
├── Tests pass locally, fail in CI
├── Inconsistent results
├── Wasted debugging time
└── Reduced confidence in automation

False Failures Impact:
├── Developer trust ↓ 60%
├── Debugging time ↑ 200%
├── Release delays ↑ 30%
└── Maintenance cost ↑ 50%
```

**Synchronization Types:**

```
1. Static Waits (Fixed time)
   ├── Simple but inefficient
   └── Always waits full duration

2. Dynamic Waits (Condition-based)
   ├── Wait until condition met
   └── Efficient and reliable

3. Implicit Waits (Global)
   ├── Applied to all operations
   └── Set once, works everywhere

4. Explicit Waits (Specific)
   ├── For specific conditions
   └── More control and precision

5. Smart Waits (Adaptive)
   ├── Learn from previous runs
   └── Optimize over time
```

**Synchronization Decision Tree:**

```
Do you need to wait?
        ↓
Is it a specific element?
    ↓               ↓
   Yes              No
    ↓               ↓
Use Explicit     Is it page load?
    Wait              ↓
                ↓           ↓
              Yes          No
                ↓           ↓
          Use Page      Use Implicit
           Sync           Wait
```

content.title: UFT Wait Methods and Techniques
content.explanation:
**Complete Wait Toolkit:**

**1. Static Waits (Thread.Sleep)**

```vbscript
' ❌ Avoid these - they waste time
Wait 5 ' Wait 5 seconds (always)

' Even worse:
Wait 10 ' Always 10 seconds

' Sometimes necessary (rare):
' For known slow operations
Wait 2 ' Minimal wait

' Better alternative with condition:
' Instead of:
Wait 5
Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync

' Use:
If Not Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(5) Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Sync", "Page took >5 seconds"
End If
```

**2. Page Synchronization**

```vbscript
' Browser/Page sync
Browser("App").Page("Login").Sync ' Wait for page load

' With timeout
Browser("App").Page("Login").Sync(10) ' Wait max 10 seconds

' Check return value
If Browser("App").Page("Login").Sync(10) Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Sync", "Page loaded within 10 seconds"
Else
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Sync", "Page load timeout"
End If

' Wait for browser navigation
Browser("App").Sync ' Wait for browser ready

' Wait for specific URL
Do While Not InStr(Browser("App").GetROProperty("url"), "dashboard") > 0
    Wait 1
    If Timer > startTime + 10 Then Exit Do
Loop
```

**3. Object Existence Waits**

```vbscript
' Check if object exists
If Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Exist(5) Then
    ' Object exists within 5 seconds
    Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set "user"
Else
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Username field not found"
End If

' Wait for object to appear
startTime = Timer
Do Until Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Exist(1)
    If Timer - startTime > 10 Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Wait", "Username field timeout"
        Exit Do
    End If
Loop

' Wait for object to disappear
Do While Browser("App").Page("Loading").Exist(1)
    Wait 1
    If Timer - startTime > 30 Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Wait", "Loading took >30 seconds"
        Exit Do
    End If
Loop
```

**4. Property-Based Waits**

```vbscript
' Wait for property to change
' Wait for element to become enabled
startTime = Timer
Do While Browser("App").Page("Form").WebButton("submit").GetROProperty("disabled") = "true"
    If Timer - startTime > 10 Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Wait", "Button never enabled"
        Exit Do
    End If
    Wait 1
Loop

' Wait for specific value
Browser("App").Page("Form").WebEdit("status").WaitProperty "value", "Success", 10

' Wait for property to change from initial value
Set obj = Browser("App").Page("Progress").WebElement("bar")
initialWidth = obj.GetROProperty("width")
obj.WaitProperty "width", initialWidth + 100, 30

' Multiple property conditions
Function WaitForProperties(obj, properties, timeout)
    startTime = Timer
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        allMatch = True
        For i = 0 to UBound(properties) Step 2
            propName = properties(i)
            expected = properties(i + 1)
            actual = obj.GetROProperty(propName)
            If actual <> expected Then
                allMatch = False
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
        
        If allMatch Then
            WaitForProperties = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForProperties = False
End Function
```

**5. Custom Wait Functions**

```vbscript
' Generic wait function
Function WaitFor(conditionFunction, timeout, checkInterval)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        If conditionFunction() Then
            WaitFor = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait checkInterval
    Loop
    
    WaitFor = False
End Function

' Usage
Function IsPageLoaded()
    IsPageLoaded = Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(0)
End Function

If WaitFor(GetRef("IsPageLoaded"), 10, 1) Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Wait", "Page loaded"
End If

' Wait for element with retry
Function WaitForObjectWithRetry(objPath, timeout, retryInterval)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        On Error Resume Next
        Set obj = Eval(objPath)
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            If obj.Exist(0) Then
                WaitForObjectWithRetry = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
        Err.Clear
        Wait retryInterval
    Loop
    
    WaitForObjectWithRetry = False
End Function

' Usage
If WaitForObjectWithRetry("Browser(""App"").Page(""Home"").WebElement(""welcome"")", 15, 1) Then
    ' Object found
End If
```

**6. Smart Wait Class**

```vbscript
' Advanced wait management
Class SmartWait
    Private defaultTimeout
    Private pollInterval
    Private lastWaitTime
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        defaultTimeout = 10
        pollInterval = 0.5
        lastWaitTime = 0
    End Sub
    
    ' Wait with adaptive timeout
    Function WaitFor(condition, context, baseTimeout)
        Dim startTime, timeout
        startTime = Timer
        
        ' Adaptive timeout based on context
        Select Case context
            Case "pageLoad"
                timeout = baseTimeout * 1.5
            Case "ajaxCall"
                timeout = baseTimeout * 0.8
            Case "animation"
                timeout = baseTimeout * 0.5
            Case Else
                timeout = baseTimeout
        End Select
        
        Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
            If condition() Then
                lastWaitTime = Timer - startTime
                WaitFor = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            Wait pollInterval
        Loop
        
        lastWaitTime = Timer - startTime
        WaitFor = False
    End Function
    
    ' Record wait metrics
    Function GetMetrics()
        Dim metrics
        metrics = "Average wait: " & lastWaitTime & " seconds"
        GetMetrics = metrics
    End Function
    
    ' Optimize wait times
    Sub LearnFromHistory(waitHistory)
        ' Adjust timeout based on historical data
        Dim avgWait
        avgWait = 0
        For Each wait In waitHistory
            avgWait = avgWait + wait
        Next
        avgWait = avgWait / UBound(waitHistory)
        
        defaultTimeout = avgWait * 1.2 ' 20% buffer
    End Sub
End Class
```

**7. UFT Built-in Wait Methods Comparison**

| Method | Description | Best For | Example |
|--------|-------------|----------|---------|
| **Wait** | Static wait | Rare, known delays | `Wait 5` |
| **Sync** | Page/browser sync | Page loads | `Browser.Sync` |
| **Exist** | Check existence | Element presence | `obj.Exist(5)` |
| **WaitProperty** | Property condition | Value changes | `obj.WaitProperty "visible", True, 10` |
| **WaitItem** | Object-specific | List items | `list.WaitItem "value"` |

**8. Wait Performance Impact**

```vbscript
' Measure wait efficiency
Function AnalyzeWaitEfficiency(waitMethod)
    Dim startTime, endTime
    
    startTime = Timer
    waitMethod()
    endTime = Timer
    
    actualWait = endTime - startTime
    
    If actualWait > 5 Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Performance", _
            "Long wait detected: " & Round(actualWait, 2) & " seconds"
    End If
    
    AnalyzeWaitEfficiency = actualWait
End Function

' Usage
waitTime = AnalyzeWaitEfficiency(Function() 
    Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(10)
End Function)
```

content.title: Synchronization with Dynamic Web Applications
content.explanation:
**Mastering Modern Web Synchronization:**

**1. AJAX and Asynchronous Operations**

```vbscript
' Handle AJAX calls
Function WaitForAjaxComplete(timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        ' Check jQuery active connections
        ajaxActive = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript("return jQuery.active")
        
        If CInt(ajaxActive) = 0 Then
            WaitForAjaxComplete = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForAjaxComplete = False
End Function

' Wait for specific AJAX response
Function WaitForAjaxResponse(containerId, expectedText, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentText = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement(containerId).GetROProperty("innertext")
        
        If InStr(currentText, expectedText) > 0 Then
            WaitForAjaxResponse = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForAjaxResponse = False
End Function
```

**2. Single Page Applications (SPA)**

```vbscript
' SPA navigation handling
Function WaitForSPATransition(initialUrl, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentUrl = Browser("App").GetROProperty("url")
        
        If currentUrl <> initialUrl Then
            ' Wait for content to load
            WaitForAjaxComplete(5)
            WaitForElementStable("main-content", 2)
            WaitForSPATransition = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForSPATransition = False
End Function

' Wait for route change
Function WaitForRoute(expectedRoute, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentRoute = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript("return window.location.hash")
        
        If InStr(currentRoute, expectedRoute) > 0 Then
            WaitForRoute = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForRoute = False
End Function
```

**3. Dynamic Element Loading**

```vbscript
' Handle elements that load dynamically
Function WaitForDynamicElement(elementPattern, timeout)
    Dim startTime, elements
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        Set desc = Description.Create()
        desc("html tag").Value = "DIV"
        desc("class").Value = elementPattern
        desc("class").RegularExpression = True
        
        Set elements = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects(desc)
        
        If elements.Count > 0 Then
            WaitForDynamicElement = elements(0)
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    Set WaitForDynamicElement = Nothing
End Function

' Wait for infinite scroll to load more items
Function WaitForInfiniteScroll(itemCount, timeout)
    Dim startTime, previousCount
    startTime = Timer
    previousCount = 0
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        ' Get current item count
        Set items = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects("class:=item")
        currentCount = items.Count
        
        If currentCount >= itemCount Then
            WaitForInfiniteScroll = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        ' If count hasn't increased, scroll
        If currentCount = previousCount Then
            Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript "window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight);"
        End If
        
        previousCount = currentCount
        Wait 2
    Loop
    
    WaitForInfiniteScroll = False
End Function
```

**4. Animation and Transitions**

```vbscript
' Wait for CSS animations to complete
Function WaitForAnimationToComplete(element, timeout)
    Dim startTime, previousPosition, stableCount
    startTime = Timer
    stableCount = 0
    previousPosition = element.GetROProperty("y")
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentPosition = element.GetROProperty("y")
        
        If currentPosition = previousPosition Then
            stableCount = stableCount + 1
            If stableCount >= 3 Then ' Stable for 3 checks
                WaitForAnimationToComplete = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        Else
            stableCount = 0
            previousPosition = currentPosition
        End If
        
        Wait 0.5
    Loop
    
    WaitForAnimationToComplete = False
End Function

' Wait for fade effect
Function WaitForFadeComplete(element, timeout)
    Dim startTime, initialOpacity
    initialOpacity = element.GetROProperty("style", "opacity")
    
    If initialOpacity = "" Then initialOpacity = 1
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentOpacity = element.GetROProperty("style", "opacity")
        If currentOpacity = "" Then currentOpacity = 1
        
        ' Fade complete when opacity reaches 1 (or 0 for fade out)
        If CDbl(currentOpacity) = 1 Or CDbl(currentOpacity) = 0 Then
            WaitForFadeComplete = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        Wait 0.5
    Loop
    
    WaitForFadeComplete = False
End Function
```

**5. Multi-Condition Synchronization**

```vbscript
' Wait for multiple conditions
Class MultiConditionWait
    Private conditions
    Private timeout
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set conditions = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Sub AddCondition(name, conditionFunction)
        conditions(name) = conditionFunction
    End Sub
    
    Function WaitAll(timeout)
        Dim startTime, metConditions
        startTime = Timer
        Set metConditions = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
            For Each cond In conditions.Keys
                If Not metConditions.Exists(cond) Then
                    If conditions(cond)() Then
                        metConditions(cond) = True
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            
            If metConditions.Count = conditions.Count Then
                WaitAll = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            
            Wait 0.5
        Loop
        
        WaitAll = False
    End Function
    
    Function WaitAny(timeout)
        Dim startTime
        startTime = Timer
        
        Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
            For Each cond In conditions.Keys
                If conditions(cond)() Then
                    WaitAny = cond
                    Exit Function
                End If
            Next
            
            Wait 0.5
        Loop
        
        WaitAny = ""
    End Function
End Class

' Usage
Set wait = New MultiConditionWait
wait.AddCondition "PageLoaded", Function() Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(0) End Function
wait.AddCondition "AjaxComplete", Function() WaitForAjaxComplete(0) End Function
wait.AddCondition "ElementVisible", Function() Browser("App").Page("Home").WebElement("welcome").Exist(0) End Function

If wait.WaitAll(15) Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Sync", "All conditions met"
Else
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Sync", "Timeout waiting for conditions"
End If
```

**6. Adaptive Wait Strategy**

```vbscript
' Learn from previous executions
Class AdaptiveWaitStrategy
    Private history
    Private currentContext
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set history = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Sub RecordWait(context, actualTime)
        If Not history.Exists(context) Then
            Set history(context) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            history(context)("times") = Array()
        End If
        
        times = history(context)("times")
        ReDim Preserve times(UBound(times) + 1)
        times(UBound(times)) = actualTime
        history(context)("times") = times
    End Sub
    
    Function GetRecommendedTimeout(context)
        If Not history.Exists(context) Then
            GetRecommendedTimeout = 10 ' Default
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        times = history(context)("times")
        
        ' Calculate recommended timeout (average + 2 standard deviations)
        Dim sum, avg, variance, stdDev
        sum = 0
        For Each t In times
            sum = sum + t
        Next
        avg = sum / (UBound(times) + 1)
        
        variance = 0
        For Each t In times
            variance = variance + (t - avg) ^ 2
        Next
        variance = variance / (UBound(times) + 1)
        stdDev = Sqr(variance)
        
        GetRecommendedTimeout = avg + (2 * stdDev) + 2 ' Add 2 second buffer
    End Function
    
    Function WaitWithLearning(context, condition, baseTimeout)
        Dim recommendedTimeout
        recommendedTimeout = GetRecommendedTimeout(context)
        
        ' Use the larger of baseTimeout and recommendedTimeout
        timeout = baseTimeout
        If recommendedTimeout > baseTimeout Then
            timeout = recommendedTimeout
            Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "AdaptiveWait", _
                "Increasing timeout to " & timeout & " based on history"
        End If
        
        startTime = Timer
        result = condition()
        actualTime = Timer - startTime
        
        RecordWait context, actualTime
        
        WaitWithLearning = result
    End Function
End Class
```

**7. Framework-Level Synchronization**

```vbscript
' Enterprise synchronization framework
Class SyncFramework
    Private defaultSettings
    Private elementWaiters
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set defaultSettings = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        defaultSettings("pageLoad") = 20
        defaultSettings("elementVisible") = 10
        defaultSettings("ajaxComplete") = 15
        defaultSettings("animation") = 5
        defaultSettings("propertyChange") = 8
        
        Set elementWaiters = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    ' Generic wait method
    Function WaitFor(context, condition, Optional timeout = -1)
        If timeout = -1 Then
            timeout = defaultSettings(context)
        End If
        
        Dim startTime
        startTime = Timer
        
        Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Sync", _
            "Waiting for " & context & " (timeout: " & timeout & "s)"
        
        Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
            If condition() Then
                WaitTime = Timer - startTime
                Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Sync", _
                    context & " satisfied after " & Round(WaitTime, 2) & "s"
                WaitFor = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            Wait 0.5
        Loop
        
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Sync", _
            context & " timeout after " & timeout & "s"
        WaitFor = False
    End Function
    
    ' Element-specific waits
    Function WaitForElement(elementPath, state, Optional timeout = -1)
        Dim condition
        
        Select Case LCase(state)
            Case "exists"
                condition = Function() 
                    On Error Resume Next
                    Set obj = Eval(elementPath)
                    WaitForElementExists = obj.Exist(0)
                End Function
            Case "visible"
                condition = Function()
                    On Error Resume Next
                    Set obj = Eval(elementPath)
                    If obj.Exist(0) Then
                        WaitForElementVisible = obj.GetROProperty("visible") = "True"
                    Else
                        WaitForElementVisible = False
                    End If
                End Function
            Case "enabled"
                condition = Function()
                    On Error Resume Next
                    Set obj = Eval(elementPath)
                    If obj.Exist(0) Then
                        WaitForElementEnabled = obj.GetROProperty("disabled") = "False"
                    Else
                        WaitForElementEnabled = False
                    End If
                End Function
        End Select
        
        WaitForElement = WaitFor("element_" & state, condition, timeout)
    End Function
    
    ' Page load wait
    Function WaitForPageLoad(Optional timeout = -1)
        If timeout = -1 Then timeout = defaultSettings("pageLoad")
        
        Dim condition
        condition = Function()
            On Error Resume Next
            WaitForPageLoad = Browser("App").Page("Page").Sync(0)
        End Function
        
        WaitForPageLoad = WaitFor("pageLoad", condition, timeout)
    End Function
    
    ' AJAX wait
    Function WaitForAjax(Optional timeout = -1)
        If timeout = -1 Then timeout = defaultSettings("ajaxComplete")
        
        Dim condition
        condition = Function()
            On Error Resume Next
            ajaxActive = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript("return jQuery.active")
            WaitForAjax = CInt(ajaxActive) = 0
        End Function
        
        WaitForAjax = WaitFor("ajaxComplete", condition, timeout)
    End Function
    
    ' Configure settings
    Sub SetTimeout(context, seconds)
        defaultSettings(context) = seconds
    End Sub
End Class

' Usage
Set sync = New SyncFramework

' Configure
sync.SetTimeout "pageLoad", 30
sync.SetTimeout "elementVisible", 15

' Use in tests
If sync.WaitForPageLoad() Then
    If sync.WaitForElement("Browser(""App"").Page(""Home"").WebElement(""welcome"")", "visible") Then
        ' Proceed with test
    End If
End If
```

content.title: Synchronization Best Practices
content.explanation:
**Proven Strategies for Reliable Tests:**

**1. Wait Strategy Decision Guide**

```
Choose the Right Wait:

For Page Loads:
├── Use: Browser.Sync or Page.Sync
├── Avoid: Wait X (static)
└── Timeout: 20-30 seconds

For Element Presence:
├── Use: obj.Exist(timeout)
├── Avoid: Wait followed by check
└── Timeout: 5-10 seconds

For Property Changes:
├── Use: obj.WaitProperty
├── Avoid: Loop with GetROProperty
└── Timeout: 10-15 seconds

For AJAX/Async:
├── Use: Custom AJAX wait
├── Avoid: Static waits
└── Timeout: 15-20 seconds
```

**2. Wait Timeout Guidelines**

| Context | Minimum | Recommended | Maximum |
|---------|---------|-------------|---------|
| **Page load** | 10s | 20s | 30s |
| **Element exists** | 3s | 5s | 10s |
| **Element visible** | 5s | 8s | 15s |
| **Property change** | 5s | 10s | 20s |
| **AJAX call** | 5s | 10s | 20s |
| **File download** | 30s | 60s | 120s |
| **Database sync** | 10s | 20s | 30s |

**3. Common Pitfalls and Solutions**

```vbscript
' Pitfall 1: Using Thread.Sleep
' ❌ Bad:
Wait 5

' ✅ Good:
If Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").WaitProperty("visible", True, 5) Then
    ' Proceed
End If

' Pitfall 2: Not checking return values
' ❌ Bad:
Browser("App").Page("Login").Sync(10)
' Continue assuming page loaded

' ✅ Good:
If Not Browser("App").Page("Login").Sync(10) Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Sync", "Page load timeout"
    ExitTest
End If

' Pitfall 3: Waiting for wrong condition
' ❌ Bad:
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").WaitProperty "exists", True, 10

' ✅ Good:
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").WaitProperty "visible", True, 10

' Pitfall 4: Infinite loops
' ❌ Bad:
Do While Not Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(1)
    Wait 1
Loop ' No timeout

' ✅ Good:
startTime = Timer
Do While Not Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(1)
    If Timer - startTime > 20 Then
        Exit Do
    End If
    Wait 1
Loop
```

**4. Performance Optimization**

```vbscript
' 1. Use the shortest effective wait
' Instead of:
Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(30) ' Always waits up to 30s

' Use:
If Not Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(10) Then
    ' Try recovery
    RefreshPage()
    If Not Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(10) Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Sync", "Page load failed"
    End If
End If

' 2. Reduce polling frequency
' Instead of checking every 0.1s:
Do While condition
    Wait 0.1 ' Too frequent
Loop

' Check every 1s:
Do While condition
    Wait 1 ' Better
Loop

' 3. Batch waits when possible
' Instead of multiple waits:
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("field1").WaitProperty "visible", True, 5
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("field2").WaitProperty "visible", True, 5
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("field3").WaitProperty "visible", True, 5

' Wait for parent container:
If Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("form").WaitProperty "visible", True, 5 Then
    ' All fields assumed visible
End If

' 4. Implement progressive timeouts
Function GetProgressiveTimeout(initialTimeout, attempts)
    ' Increase timeout with each attempt
    GetProgressiveTimeout = initialTimeout * (1 + (attempts * 0.5))
End Function
```

**5. Error Handling with Waits**

```vbscript
' Robust error handling for waits
Function SafeWaitForObject(objPath, timeout, recoveryAction)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        Set obj = Eval(objPath)
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            If obj.Exist(0) Then
                SafeWaitForObject = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        Else
            Err.Clear
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    ' Timeout - try recovery
    Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Wait", _
        "Object not found, attempting recovery"
    
    If recoveryAction() Then
        ' Retry once
        SafeWaitForObject = SafeWaitForObject(objPath, timeout, recoveryAction)
    Else
        SafeWaitForObject = False
    End If
End Function

' Recovery action example
Function RefreshAndRetry()
    Browser("App").Refresh
    Wait 2
    RefreshAndRetry = True
End Function

' Usage
If SafeWaitForObject("Browser(""App"").Page(""Home"").WebElement(""welcome"")", _
                     10, GetRef("RefreshAndRetry")) Then
    ' Object found
Else
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Wait", "Object not found after recovery"
End If
```

**6. Wait Configuration Management**

```vbscript
' Centralized wait configuration
Class WaitConfiguration
    Private config
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set config = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        LoadDefaults()
        LoadFromFile()
    End Sub
    
    Private Sub LoadDefaults()
        config("pageLoad.default") = 20
        config("pageLoad.slow") = 30
        config("pageLoad.fast") = 10
        
        config("element.default") = 10
        config("element.slow") = 15
        config("element.fast") = 5
        
        config("ajax.default") = 15
        config("ajax.slow") = 25
        config("ajax.fast") = 8
    End Sub
    
    Private Sub LoadFromFile()
        Dim fso, file
        Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
        
        If fso.FileExists("C:\UFT\Config\WaitConfig.ini") Then
            ' Parse INI file and override defaults
        End If
    End Sub
    
    Function GetTimeout(category, speed)
        key = category & "." & speed
        If config.Exists(key) Then
            GetTimeout = config(key)
        Else
            GetTimeout = config(category & ".default")
        End If
    End Function
    
    Sub SetTimeout(category, speed, value)
        config(category & "." & speed) = value
    End Sub
End Class
```

**7. Synchronization Checklist**

```
✓ Pre-Execution:
□ Set appropriate global timeouts
□ Configure environment-specific waits
□ Load wait configuration

✓ During Test:
□ Use explicit waits for critical elements
□ Check return values of wait methods
□ Log wait times for performance tracking
□ Handle timeout exceptions gracefully

✓ Post-Execution:
□ Analyze wait performance metrics
□ Identify slow operations
□ Adjust wait times based on trends
□ Document any timing issues

✓ Maintenance:
□ Review wait times quarterly
□ Update for application changes
□ Optimize based on historical data
□ Remove redundant waits
```

**8. Real-World Examples**

```vbscript
' Example 1: Login with proper waits
Function TestLoginWithSync(username, password)
    ' Wait for login page
    If Not Browser("App").Page("Login").Sync(15) Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Login page not loaded"
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Wait for username field
    If Not Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").WaitProperty("visible", True, 5) Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Username field not visible"
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Enter credentials
    Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set username
    Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("password").SetSecure password
    
    ' Click login and wait for response
    Browser("App").Page("Login").WebButton("login").Click
    
    ' Wait for either home page or error message
    Set wait = New MultiConditionWait
    wait.AddCondition "HomePage", Function() Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(0) End Function
    wait.AddCondition "Error", Function() Browser("App").Page("Login").WebElement("error").Exist(0) End Function
    
    result = wait.WaitAny(10)
    
    Select Case result
        Case "HomePage"
            Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Login", "Login successful"
            TestLoginWithSync = True
        Case "Error"
            errorMsg = Browser("App").Page("Login").WebElement("error").GetROProperty("innertext")
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Login failed: " & errorMsg
            TestLoginWithSync = False
        Case Else
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "No response after login"
            TestLoginWithSync = False
    End Select
End Function

' Example 2: Data loading with progress indicator
Function WaitForDataLoad()
    ' Wait for loading indicator to appear
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    ' Wait for loading to start (within 3 seconds)
    Do While Not Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("loading").Exist(1)
        If Timer - startTime > 3 Then
            ' No loading indicator - maybe data already loaded
            Exit Do
        End If
    Loop
    
    ' Wait for loading to finish
    Do While Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("loading").Exist(1)
        If Timer - startTime > 30 Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Data", "Data load timeout"
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    ' Wait for data to render
    WaitForAjaxComplete(5)
    WaitForElementStable("data-container", 2)
    
    Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Data", "Data loaded in " & Round(Timer - startTime, 2) & "s"
End Function
```

**9. Performance Metrics**

```vbscript
' Track synchronization efficiency
Class SyncMetrics
    Private metrics
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set metrics = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Sub RecordWait(context, waitTime, result)
        If Not metrics.Exists(context) Then
            Set metrics(context) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            metrics(context)("count") = 0
            metrics(context)("totalTime") = 0
            metrics(context)("maxTime") = 0
            metrics(context)("timeouts") = 0
        End If
        
        metrics(context)("count") = metrics(context)("count") + 1
        metrics(context)("totalTime") = metrics(context)("totalTime") + waitTime
        
        If waitTime > metrics(context)("maxTime") Then
            metrics(context)("maxTime") = waitTime
        End If
        
        If Not result Then
            metrics(context)("timeouts") = metrics(context)("timeouts") + 1
        End If
    End Sub
    
    Function GetReport()
        Dim report
        report = "Synchronization Performance Report" & vbNewLine
        report = report & String(50, "=") & vbNewLine
        
        For Each context In metrics.Keys
            avgTime = metrics(context)("totalTime") / metrics(context)("count")
            timeoutRate = (metrics(context)("timeouts") / metrics(context)("count")) * 100
            
            report = report & context & vbNewLine
            report = report & "  Calls: " & metrics(context)("count") & vbNewLine
            report = report & "  Avg Wait: " & Round(avgTime, 2) & "s" & vbNewLine
            report = report & "  Max Wait: " & Round(metrics(context)("maxTime"), 2) & "s" & vbNewLine
            report = report & "  Timeout Rate: " & Round(timeoutRate, 2) & "%" & vbNewLine
        Next
        
        GetReport = report
    End Function
End Class
```

**10. Summary: The Golden Rules of Synchronization**

```
1. Never use static waits (Wait X) in production tests
2. Always check return values of wait methods
3. Use the smallest effective timeout
4. Wait for business conditions, not just element existence
5. Implement timeouts in all loops
6. Log wait times for performance monitoring
7. Adapt timeouts based on environment
8. Handle timeout exceptions gracefully
9. Batch waits when possible
10. Continuously optimize based on metrics
```

content.title: What is Parameterization in UFT?
content.explanation:
**The Power of Data-Driven Testing:**

Parameterization is the process of replacing hard-coded values in test scripts with variables that can accept different data inputs, enabling the same test to run with multiple data sets.

**The Concept:**

```
Without Parameterization (Hard-coded):
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set "john"
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("password").Set "pass123"

With Parameterization:
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set DataTable("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("password").Set DataTable("Password", dtGlobalSheet)

Data Table:
| Username | Password |
|----------|----------|
| john     | pass123  |
| jane     | secret   |
| bob      | test456  |
```

**Why Parameterization Matters:**

| Benefit | Without Parameterization | With Parameterization | Impact |
|---------|-------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| **Test Coverage** | 1 scenario per test | Multiple scenarios | 1000% more coverage |
| **Maintenance** | Update all scripts | Update data only | 80% faster |
| **Reusability** | Low | High | 70% less code |
| **Data Separation** | Mixed with code | Separated | Cleaner tests |
| **Flexibility** | Rigid | Dynamic | Adapts to changes |

**Parameterization Architecture:**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Parameterization Sources                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐          │
│  │  Data Table  │  │ Environment  │  │   External   │          │
│  │  (Built-in)  │  │  Variables   │  │    Files     │          │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘          │
│         │               │               │                        │
│         ▼               ▼               ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                    Test Execution                          │   │
│  │  Test runs once per row/iteration with different data     │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│         │               │               │                        │
│         ▼               ▼               ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐          │
│  │   Test Row 1 │  │   Test Row 2 │  │   Test Row 3 │          │
│  │   John/pass  │  │   Jane/secret│  │   Bob/test   │          │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘          │
│                                                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Types of Parameterization in UFT:**

| Type | Source | Best For | Complexity |
|------|--------|----------|------------|
| **Data Table** | Built-in Excel-like table | Simple test data | Low |
| **Environment Variables** | UFT/System variables | Configuration data | Low |
| **Action Parameters** | Input/output between actions | Component reuse | Medium |
| **Random Numbers** | Generated values | Unique data | Low |
| **External Excel** | External .xls files | Large datasets | Medium |
| **Database** | SQL queries | Dynamic/real data | High |
| **XML/JSON** | Structured files | Complex data | High |
| **Custom Functions** | Programmatic generation | Special needs | High |

**When to Use Parameterization:**

✅ **Data-Driven Testing** – Same test, different inputs
✅ **Configuration Management** – Environment-specific settings
✅ **Cross-Browser Testing** – Browser parameters
✅ **Localization Testing** – Multiple languages
✅ **Boundary Testing** – Edge cases
✅ **Load Testing** – Multiple users
✅ **Regression Testing** – Historical data

**Parameterization ROI:**

```
100 Tests × 10 Data Sets = 1000 Test Scenarios

Without Parameterization:
├── Write 1000 separate tests
├── Maintenance nightmare
├── 1000 hours to create
└── 500 hours/year to maintain

With Parameterization:
├── Write 100 parameterized tests
├── Maintain 10 data sets
├── 200 hours to create
└── 100 hours/year to maintain

Savings: 800 hours initial + 400 hours/year
```

content.title: Mastering UFT Data Table
content.explanation:
**The Built-in Parameterization Powerhouse:**

**1. Data Table Structure**

```vbscript
' UFT Data Table has two sheets:

Global Sheet:
├── Used for driver iterations
├── One row per test iteration
├── Accessible everywhere
└── Controls test flow

Local Sheet (Action-specific):
├── Specific to an action
├── Independent iterations
├── Good for action-level data
└── Not shared across actions

Data Table Interface:
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│ Global Sheet                    │
├──────┬────────┬────────┬──────┤
│ Row  │ Username│ Password│ Role│
├──────┼────────┼────────┼──────┤
│ 1    │ user1  │ pass1  │ admin│
│ 2    │ user2  │ pass2  │ user │
│ 3    │ user3  │ pass3  │ guest│
└──────┴────────┴────────┴──────┘
```

**2. Accessing Data Table Values**

```vbscript
' Basic data access
username = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
password = DataTable.Value("Password", dtGlobalSheet)

' Alternative syntax
username = DataTable("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
password = DataTable("Password", dtGlobalSheet)

' Local sheet access
actionData = DataTable.Value("Input", dtLocalSheet)

' Using in test steps
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set DataTable("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("password").Set DataTable("Password", dtGlobalSheet)

' Get row count
rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount

' Get current row
currentRow = DataTable.GetCurrentRow()

' Set value programmatically
DataTable.Value("Result", dtGlobalSheet) = "Passed"
DataTable.Value("ExecutionTime", dtGlobalSheet) = Timer - startTime
```

**3. Data Table Methods**

```vbscript
' Import/Export operations
' Import from Excel
DataTable.Import "C:\TestData\LoginData.xls"

' Import specific sheet
DataTable.ImportSheet "C:\TestData\TestData.xls", "Sheet1", "Global"

' Export results
DataTable.Export "C:\Results\TestResults.xls"

' Export specific sheet
DataTable.ExportSheet "C:\Results\Results.xls", "Global"

' Add new sheet
DataTable.AddSheet "APITestData"

' Delete sheet
DataTable.DeleteSheet "TempSheet"

' Check if sheet exists
If DataTable.GetSheet("Config") Is Nothing Then
    DataTable.AddSheet "Config"
End If

' Get sheet object
Set sheet = DataTable.GetSheet("Global")
Set sheet = DataTable.LocalSheet ' Current action's local sheet

' Clear data
DataTable.ClearSheet "Global"
DataTable.ClearAll ' Clear all sheets
```

**4. Row Navigation and Iteration**

```vbscript
' Manual row navigation
For row = 1 to DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow row
    
    ' Use data
    username = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
    password = DataTable.Value("Password", dtGlobalSheet)
    
    ' Execute test with this data
    Call ExecuteLoginTest(username, password)
Next

' Automatic iteration (set in Test Settings)
' File → Settings → Run → Data Table iterations
' Options:
' - Run one iteration
' - Run on all rows
' - Run from row X to row Y

' Nested iterations
For Each browser In browsers
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow 1
    Do While Not DataTable.GetSheet("Global").IsLastRow
        username = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
        Call TestWithBrowser(browser, username)
        DataTable.SetNextRow
    Loop
Next

' Skip rows conditionally
If environment = "prod" Then
    ' Skip test data marked for dev only
    Do While Not DataTable.GetSheet("Global").IsLastRow
        env = DataTable.Value("Environment", dtGlobalSheet)
        If env <> "dev" Then
            Call ExecuteTest()
        End If
        DataTable.SetNextRow
    Loop
End If
```

**5. Parameterizing Test Steps**

```vbscript
' Method 1: Through UI
1. Right-click on value in Keyword View
2. Select "Parameterize"
3. Choose parameter type:
   - Data Table parameter
   - Environment variable
   - Random number
4. Configure parameter
5. Click OK

' Method 2: Direct code
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").Set DataTable("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("password").Set DataTable("Password", dtGlobalSheet)

' Method 3: Using variables
Dim testUser, testPass
testUser = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
testPass = DataTable.Value("Password", dtGlobalSheet)

Call Login(testUser, testPass)

' Method 4: Dynamic parameters
' Use column index instead of name
username = DataTable.Value(1, dtGlobalSheet) ' First column
password = DataTable.Value(2, dtGlobalSheet) ' Second column
```

**6. Advanced Data Table Techniques**

```vbscript
' Dynamic column access
Function GetColumnValue(columnName)
    On Error Resume Next
    value = DataTable.Value(columnName, dtGlobalSheet)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        ' Column doesn't exist, use default
        GetColumnValue = ""
    Else
        GetColumnValue = value
    End If
End Function

' Multi-sheet data management
' Test data organized by module
DataTable.ImportSheet "TestData.xls", "LoginData", "Global"
DataTable.ImportSheet "TestData.xls", "PaymentData", "Payment"
DataTable.ImportSheet "TestData.xls", "ShippingData", "Shipping"

' Data transformation
Function PrepareTestData()
    rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount
    
    For row = 1 to rowCount
        DataTable.SetCurrentRow row
        
        ' Combine data
        fullName = DataTable.Value("FirstName", dtGlobalSheet) & " " & _
                   DataTable.Value("LastName", dtGlobalSheet)
        DataTable.Value("FullName", dtGlobalSheet) = fullName
        
        ' Format data
        phone = DataTable.Value("Phone", dtGlobalSheet)
        If Len(phone) = 10 Then
            formattedPhone = "(" & Left(phone, 3) & ") " & _
                             Mid(phone, 4, 3) & "-" & Right(phone, 4)
            DataTable.Value("FormattedPhone", dtGlobalSheet) = formattedPhone
        End If
        
        DataTable.SetNextRow
    Next
End Function

' Data validation
Function ValidateTestData()
    Dim errors
    errors = 0
    
    rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount
    
    For row = 1 to rowCount
        DataTable.SetCurrentRow row
        
        username = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
        password = DataTable.Value("Password", dtGlobalSheet)
        
        If username = "" Then
            errors = errors + 1
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Data Validation", _
                "Row " & row & ": Username is empty"
        End If
        
        If Len(password) < 6 Then
            errors = errors + 1
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Data Validation", _
                "Row " & row & ": Password too short"
        End If
        
        DataTable.SetNextRow
    Next
    
    ValidateTestData = errors
End Function
```

**7. Data Table Best Practices**

```vbscript
' 1. Use meaningful column names
' Good: "Username", "Password", "ExpectedResult"
' Bad: "Col1", "Col2", "Data"

' 2. Include headers and documentation
' First row: Column names
' Second row: Description (optional)
' Third row: Start data

' 3. Use consistent data types
' All values in a column should be same type

' 4. Handle empty values
If DataTable.Value("Optional", dtGlobalSheet) <> "" Then
    ' Use value
Else
    ' Use default
End If

' 5. Cache row count for performance
rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount
For i = 1 to rowCount ' Fast
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow i
    ' Process
Next

' 6. Export results for reporting
DataTable.Value("Status", dtGlobalSheet) = testStatus
DataTable.Value("Error", dtGlobalSheet) = errorMessage
DataTable.Export "C:\Results\" & testName & "_" & GetTimestamp() & ".xls"

' 7. Use multiple sheets for organization
' Global: Test iterations
' Config: Environment settings
' Expected: Expected results
' Actual: Captured results
```

**8. Common Data Table Patterns**

```vbscript
' Pattern 1: Positive/Negative testing
' Data Table:
| TestCase | Username | Password | ExpectedResult |
|----------|----------|----------|----------------|
| TC01     | valid    | valid    | Success        |
| TC02     | valid    | invalid  | Error          |
| TC03     | invalid  | valid    | Error          |
| TC04     | empty    | valid    | Error          |

' Pattern 2: Configuration data
| Environment | URL           | Browser | Timeout |
|-------------|---------------|---------|---------|
| Dev         | http://dev    | chrome  | 30      |
| Test        | http://test   | firefox | 45      |
| Staging     | http://staging| chrome  | 60      |

' Pattern 3: Expected results matrix
| Input | Output1 | Output2 | Output3 |
|-------|---------|---------|---------|
| A     | X       | Y       | Z       |
| B     | X       | Y       | W       |
| C     | X       | Z       | W       |

' Pattern 4: Test oracles
| TestID | Input    | ExpectedDBState | ExpectedUI |
|--------|----------|-----------------|------------|
| T01    | create   | user_added      | success    |
| T02    | update   | user_modified   | updated    |
| T03    | delete   | user_removed    | deleted    |
```

**9. Performance Considerations**

```vbscript
' Optimize Data Table operations

' Bad: Accessing inside loop without caching
For i = 1 to DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount ' Called each iteration
    ' Slow
Next

' Good: Cache row count
rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount
For i = 1 to rowCount ' Fast
    ' Process
Next

' Bad: Multiple value retrievals
username = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
' ... 50 lines of code ...
If DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet) = "admin" Then ' Another retrieval

' Good: Store in variable
username = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
' ... 50 lines of code ...
If username = "admin" Then ' Use variable

' Batch operations
' Instead of updating row by row:
For i = 1 to rowCount
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow i
    DataTable.Value("Status", dtGlobalSheet) = status
    DataTable.SetNextRow
Next

' Collect results and export at end:
For i = 1 to rowCount
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow i
    statusArray(i) = testStatus
Next
' After loop, update all at once
```

**10. Data Table Helper Class**

```vbscript
' Comprehensive Data Table wrapper
Class DataTableManager
    Private currentSheet
    Private sheetName
    
    Sub Class_Initialize()
        currentSheet = dtGlobalSheet
        sheetName = "Global"
    End Sub
    
    ' Set active sheet
    Sub UseSheet(sheet)
        If TypeName(sheet) = "String" Then
            Set currentSheet = DataTable.GetSheet(sheet)
            sheetName = sheet
        Else
            Set currentSheet = sheet
            sheetName = sheet.Name
        End If
    End Sub
    
    ' Get value with default
    Function GetValue(column, defaultValue)
        On Error Resume Next
        value = DataTable.Value(column, currentSheet)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Or value = "" Then
            GetValue = defaultValue
        Else
            GetValue = value
        End If
    End Function
    
    ' Set value
    Sub SetValue(column, value)
        DataTable.Value(column, currentSheet) = value
    End Sub
    
    ' Get row as dictionary
    Function GetRowAsDict()
        Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        ' Get all columns
        Set sheet = DataTable.GetSheet(sheetName)
        colCount = sheet.GetParameterCount
        
        For col = 1 to colCount
            colName = sheet.GetParameterName(col)
            dict(colName) = DataTable.Value(colName, currentSheet)
        Next
        
        Set GetRowAsDict = dict
    End Function
    
    ' Import with validation
    Function SafeImport(filePath, sourceSheet, destSheet)
        On Error Resume Next
        
        DataTable.ImportSheet filePath, sourceSheet, destSheet
        
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            SafeImport = False
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Data Import", _
                "Failed to import: " & Err.Description
            Err.Clear
        Else
            SafeImport = True
        End If
    End Function
    
    ' Get data statistics
    Function GetStats()
        Dim stats
        Set sheet = DataTable.GetSheet(sheetName)
        
        stats = "Sheet: " & sheetName & vbNewLine
        stats = stats & "Rows: " & sheet.GetRowCount & vbNewLine
        stats = stats & "Columns: " & sheet.GetParameterCount & vbNewLine
        
        GetStats = stats
    End Function
    
    ' Iterate with callback
    Sub ForEachRow(callback)
        Dim originalRow
        originalRow = DataTable.GetCurrentRow()
        
        rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet(sheetName).GetRowCount
        
        For row = 1 to rowCount
            DataTable.SetCurrentRow row
            callback()
        Next
        
        ' Restore original row
        DataTable.SetCurrentRow originalRow
    End Sub
End Class

' Usage
Set dt = New DataTableManager
dt.UseSheet "Global"
username = dt.GetValue("Username", "default")
dt.SetValue "Status", "Passed"
```

content.title: Using Environment Variables for Configuration
content.explanation:
**Managing Test Configuration:**

**1. Types of Environment Variables**

```vbscript
' UFT has three types of environment variables:

1. Built-in (Read-only)
   ├── ProductVersion
   ├── OS
   ├── LocalHostName
   └── UserName

2. User-defined (Read/Write during test)
   ├── Created in test
   ├── Can be modified
   └── Lost after test

3. External (Loaded from file)
   ├── Load from XML file
   ├── Persistent across tests
   └── Good for configuration
```

**2. Accessing Environment Variables**

```vbscript
' Built-in variables
MsgBox Environment.Value("ProductVersion")
MsgBox Environment.Value("OS")
MsgBox Environment.Value("LocalHostName")
MsgBox Environment.Value("UserName")

' User-defined variables
Environment.Value("BaseURL") = "http://test.example.com"
Environment.Value("Browser") = "chrome"
Environment.Value("Timeout") = "30"

' Using in tests
Browser(Environment.Value("Browser")).Navigate Environment.Value("BaseURL")

' Check if exists
If Environment.Exists("ProxyServer") Then
    ' Use proxy
Else
    ' No proxy
End If

' Remove variable
Environment.Value("TempVar") = "" ' Set to empty
' or use Environment.Unload (if available)
```

**3. External Environment Files**

```xml
<!-- environment.xml -->
<Environment>
    <Variable>
        <Name>BaseURL</Name>
        <Value>http://test.example.com</Value>
    </Variable>
    <Variable>
        <Name>Browser</Name>
        <Value>chrome</Value>
    </Variable>
    <Variable>
        <Name>Timeout</Name>
        <Value>30</Value>
    </Variable>
    <Variable>
        <Name>AdminUser</Name>
        <Value>admin</Value>
    </Variable>
    <Variable>
        <Name>AdminPass</Name>
        <Value>EncryptedValue</Value>
    </Variable>
</Environment>
```

```vbscript
' Load environment file
Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\environment.xml"

' Verify load
If Environment.Exists("BaseURL") Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Config", "Environment loaded"
Else
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Config", "Environment not loaded"
End If

' Environment-specific configurations
Function GetEnvironmentConfig(env)
    Select Case env
        Case "dev"
            Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\dev.xml"
        Case "test"
            Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\test.xml"
        Case "staging"
            Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\staging.xml"
        Case "prod"
            Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\prod.xml"
    End Select
End Function

' Export environment
Environment.ExportToFile "C:\UFT\Config\exported.xml"
```

**4. Environment Variable Patterns**

```vbscript
' Pattern 1: Environment-based configuration
' File: dev.xml
Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\" & environment & ".xml"

baseURL = Environment.Value("BaseURL")
dbConnection = Environment.Value("DBConnection")
apiKey = Environment.Value("APIKey")

' Pattern 2: Feature toggles
Environment.Value("EnableLogging") = "true"
Environment.Value("UseNewUI") = "false"
Environment.Value("RetryOnFailure") = "3"

If Environment.Value("UseNewUI") = "true" Then
    ' Use new UI locators
Else
    ' Use old UI locators
End If

' Pattern 3: Credential management
' Store encrypted in environment file
' Decrypt at runtime
Function GetDecryptedPassword()
    encrypted = Environment.Value("AdminPass")
    GetDecryptedPassword = Decrypt(encrypted)
End Function

' Pattern 4: Test run metadata
Environment.Value("TestRunID") = GetTimestamp()
Environment.Value("Tester") = GetTesterName()
Environment.Value("BuildNumber") = GetBuildNumber()

' Use in reporting
Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Run Info", _
    "Run ID: " & Environment.Value("TestRunID") & ", " & _
    "Tester: " & Environment.Value("Tester")
```

**5. Environment Variable Manager**

```vbscript
' Comprehensive environment management
Class EnvironmentManager
    Private configPath
    Private loadedFiles
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        configPath = "C:\UFT\Config\"
        Set loadedFiles = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    ' Load environment configuration
    Function LoadEnvironment(env)
        Dim filePath
        filePath = configPath & env & ".xml"
        
        On Error Resume Next
        Environment.LoadFromFile filePath
        
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            loadedFiles(env) = filePath
            LoadEnvironment = True
            Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Environment", _
                "Loaded " & env & " configuration"
        Else
            LoadEnvironment = False
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Environment", _
                "Failed to load " & env & ": " & Err.Description
        End If
    End Function
    
    ' Get with default
    Function GetConfig(key, defaultValue)
        If Environment.Exists(key) Then
            GetConfig = Environment.Value(key)
        Else
            GetConfig = defaultValue
        End If
    End Function
    
    ' Set configuration
    Sub SetConfig(key, value)
        Environment.Value(key) = value
    End Sub
    
    ' Get all as dictionary
    Function GetAllConfig()
        Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        ' This is simplified - actual implementation
        ' would need to enumerate all env vars
        
        Set GetAllConfig = dict
    End Function
    
    ' Merge multiple configurations
    Function MergeConfigs(envs)
        For Each env In envs
            Call LoadEnvironment(env)
        Next
    End Function
    
    ' Reset to defaults
    Sub ResetToDefaults()
        ' Clear user-defined vars
        ' Load base configuration
        Environment.LoadFromFile configPath & "default.xml"
    End Sub
    
    ' Validate required config
    Function ValidateRequired(requiredKeys)
        Dim missing
        missing = ""
        
        For Each key In requiredKeys
            If Not Environment.Exists(key) Then
                missing = missing & key & ", "
            End If
        Next
        
        If missing = "" Then
            ValidateRequired = True
        Else
            ValidateRequired = False
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Config", _
                "Missing required keys: " & Left(missing, Len(missing)-2)
        End If
    End Function
End Class

' Usage
Set envMgr = New EnvironmentManager
If envMgr.LoadEnvironment("staging") Then
    baseURL = envMgr.GetConfig("BaseURL", "http://default.com")
    timeout = envMgr.GetConfig("Timeout", "30")
End If
```

**6. Environment vs Data Table**

| Aspect | Environment Variables | Data Table |
|--------|----------------------|------------|
| **Scope** | Global across test | Per iteration |
| **Persistence** | Across actions | Per row |
| **Best For** | Configuration | Test data |
| **Modification** | Any time | Per iteration |
| **Performance** | Fast | Fast |
| **Complexity** | Simple | Moderate |
| **External files** | XML | Excel |

**7. Best Practices**

```vbscript
' 1. Use environment for configuration, not test data
' Good:
Environment.Value("BaseURL") = "http://app.com"
Environment.Value("Browser") = "chrome"

' Bad:
Environment.Value("Username1") = "user1" ' Use Data Table instead

' 2. Load environment at test start
Sub TestInitialize()
    Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\" & environment & ".xml"
    
    ' Validate critical variables
    required = Array("BaseURL", "Browser", "Timeout")
    For Each req In required
        If Not Environment.Exists(req) Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Setup", _
                "Missing required config: " & req
            ExitTest
        End If
    Next
End Sub

' 3. Use meaningful names
' Good: "DatabaseConnectionString"
' Bad: "DB1"

' 4. Document environment variables
' Create a README with all variables, their purpose, and examples

' 5. Version control environment files
' Store in source control with .sample versions
' Don't store real passwords in version control

' 6. Use hierarchy
Environment.Value("DB.Host") = "localhost"
Environment.Value("DB.Port") = "1433"
Environment.Value("DB.Name") = "testdb"

' 7. Cache frequently used values
baseURL = Environment.Value("BaseURL") ' Get once
```

**8. Advanced: Dynamic Environment Switching**

```vbscript
' Runtime environment switching
Class RuntimeEnvironment
    Private currentEnv
    Private envConfigs
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set envConfigs = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        LoadAllConfigs()
    End Sub
    
    Private Sub LoadAllConfigs()
        ' Pre-load all environment configs
        envConfigs("dev") = LoadConfigFile("dev.xml")
        envConfigs("test") = LoadConfigFile("test.xml")
        envConfigs("staging") = LoadConfigFile("staging.xml")
        envConfigs("prod") = LoadConfigFile("prod.xml")
    End Sub
    
    Function LoadConfigFile(fileName)
        Dim config
        Set config = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        ' Parse XML and populate dictionary
        ' ...
        
        Set LoadConfigFile = config
    End Function
    
    Sub SwitchTo(env)
        If envConfigs.Exists(env) Then
            currentEnv = env
            ApplyConfig envConfigs(env)
        Else
            Err.Raise 1, "RuntimeEnvironment", "Unknown environment: " & env
        End If
    End Sub
    
    Private Sub ApplyConfig(config)
        ' Apply to environment variables
        For Each key In config.Keys
            Environment.Value(key) = config(key)
        Next
    End Sub
    
    Function GetCurrentEnv()
        GetCurrentEnv = currentEnv
    End Function
End Class
```

**9. Integration with CI/CD**

```vbscript
' Pass environment variables from CI/CD
' Jenkins: Build with parameters
' Parameter: ENV=staging
' Parameter: BROWSER=chrome

' In UFT test
env = Environment.Value("ENV")
If env = "" Then env = "dev" ' Default

browser = Environment.Value("BROWSER")
If browser = "" Then browser = "chrome"

' Load appropriate config
Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\UFT\Config\" & env & ".xml"
Environment.Value("Browser") = browser

' Azure DevOps variable group
' Variable group: TestConfiguration
' Variables: BaseURL, Browser, Timeout

' Access in UFT (via command line)
' UFT.exe -run ... -param "BaseURL=$(BaseURL);Browser=$(Browser)"
```

**10. Troubleshooting**

```vbscript
' Common issues and solutions

' Issue 1: Variable not found
If Not Environment.Exists("BaseURL") Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Config", _
        "BaseURL not set, using default"
    Environment.Value("BaseURL") = "http://localhost"
End If

' Issue 2: Wrong variable type
' All environment variables are strings
' Convert as needed
timeout = CInt(Environment.Value("Timeout"))
enableLogging = CBool(Environment.Value("EnableLogging"))

' Issue 3: File not found
On Error Resume Next
Environment.LoadFromFile "C:\Config\settings.xml"
If Err.Number <> 0 Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Config", _
        "Config file not found, using defaults"
    SetDefaultConfig()
    Err.Clear
End If

' Issue 4: Special characters
' XML escape if needed
Function EscapeXML(value)
    value = Replace(value, "&", "&")
    value = Replace(value, "<", "<")
    value = Replace(value, ">", ">")
    value = Replace(value, """", """)
    value = Replace(value, "'", "'")
    EscapeXML = value
End Function
```

content.title: Working with External Data Sources
content.explanation:
**Beyond the Built-in Data Table:**

**1. Excel Files**

```vbscript
' Direct Excel manipulation
Set excel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
excel.Visible = False

Set workbook = excel.Workbooks.Open("C:\\TestData\\TestData.xlsx")
Set worksheet = workbook.Worksheets("LoginTests")

' Read data
rowCount = worksheet.UsedRange.Rows.Count
colCount = worksheet.UsedRange.Columns.Count

For row = 2 to rowCount ' Skip header
    username = worksheet.Cells(row, 1).Value
    password = worksheet.Cells(row, 2).Value
    expected = worksheet.Cells(row, 3).Value

    ' Use data
    Call RunTest(username, password, expected)
Next

' Write results
worksheet.Cells(row, 4).Value = "Passed"
worksheet.Cells(row, 5).Value = Now()

' Save and close
workbook.SaveAs "C:\\Results\\TestResults_" & GetTimestamp() & ".xlsx"
workbook.Close
excel.Quit
Set excel = Nothing
```

**2. CSV Files**

```vbscript
Function ReadCSV(filePath)
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set file = fso.OpenTextFile(filePath, 1)

    Dim data
    Set data = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    header = Split(file.ReadLine(), ",")

    rowNum = 1
    Do While file.AtEndOfStream <> True
        line = file.ReadLine()
        values = ParseCSVLine(line)

        Set row = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        For i = 0 to UBound(header)
            row(Trim(header(i))) = Trim(values(i))
        Next

        data(rowNum) = row
        rowNum = rowNum + 1
    Loop

    file.Close
    Set ReadCSV = data
End Function
```

**3. Database Parameterization**

```vbscript
Function GetDatabaseData(connectionString, query)
    Set conn = CreateObject("ADODB.Connection")
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")

    conn.Open connectionString
    rs.Open query, conn

    Set data = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    rowNum = 1

    Do While Not rs.EOF
        Set row = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

        For Each field In rs.Fields
            row(field.Name) = field.Value
        Next

        data(rowNum) = row
        rowNum = rowNum + 1
        rs.MoveNext
    Loop

    rs.Close
    conn.Close

    Set GetDatabaseData = data
End Function
```

**4. XML Data Sources**

```vbscript
Function ReadXMLData(filePath)
    Set xml = CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument")
    xml.async = False
    xml.load(filePath)

    Set data = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Set testCases = xml.selectNodes("//testcase")

    For Each testCase in testCases
        Set row = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

        row("id") = testCase.getAttribute("id")

        Set inputs = testCase.selectNodes("input")
        For Each input in inputs
            row(input.getAttribute("name")) = input.Text
        Next

        data(data.Count + 1) = row
    Next

    Set ReadXMLData = data
End Function
```

**5. JSON Data Sources**

```vbscript
Function ParseJSON(jsonString)
    Set regex = New RegExp
    regex.Pattern = "\"(\\w+)\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\""
    regex.Global = True

    Set matches = regex.Execute(jsonString)
    Set result = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    For Each match in matches
        result(match.SubMatches(0)) = match.SubMatches(1)
    Next

    Set ParseJSON = result
End Function
```

**6. Hybrid Data Provider**

```vbscript
Class DataProvider
    Private dataSource
    Private data
    Private currentIndex

    Function HasNext()
        HasNext = currentIndex < data.Count
    End Function

    Function GetNext()
        currentIndex = currentIndex + 1
        Set GetNext = data(currentIndex)
    End Function

    Function GetCount()
        GetCount = data.Count
    End Function

    Sub Reset()
        currentIndex = 0
    End Sub
End Class
```

**7. Data Generation**

```vbscript
Function RandomString(length)
    Dim chars, result
    chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
    result = ""

    For i = 1 to length
        result = result & Mid(chars, Int(Rnd * Len(chars)) + 1, 1)
    Next

    RandomString = result
End Function
```

**8. Data Masking and Security**

```vbscript
Function MaskData(value, visibleChars)
    If Len(value) <= visibleChars Then
        MaskData = String(Len(value), "*")
    Else
        visible = Right(value, visibleChars)
        masked = String(Len(value) - visibleChars, "*")
        MaskData = masked & visible
    End If
End Function
```

**9. Performance Optimization with External Data**

```vbscript
Class DataCache
    Private cache

    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set cache = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub

    Function GetData(key, loader)
        If cache.Exists(key) Then
            Set GetData = cache(key)
        Else
            Set data = loader()
            cache(key) = data
            Set GetData = data
        End If
    End Function
End Class
```

**10. Best Practices Summary**

Separate test logic from test data, validate inputs before execution, use environment-specific datasets, secure sensitive information, and always clean up resources after execution.

content.title: Mastering Web Element Recognition
content.explanation:
**Comprehensive Web Element Guide:**

**1. Web Element Types in UFT**

| Element Class | Description | Common Properties |
|--------------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Browser** | Browser window | title, url, handle |
| **Page** | Web page | title, url |
| **WebEdit** | Text input fields | name, type, value |
| **WebButton** | Buttons | name, value, type |
| **WebList** | Dropdown lists | name, items count |
| **WebCheckBox** | Checkboxes | name, checked |
| **WebRadioGroup** | Radio buttons | name, value |
| **WebElement** | Generic element | html tag, innertext |
| **Link** | Hyperlinks | text, url |
| **Image** | Images | alt, src |
| **WebTable** | HTML tables | rows, columns |
| **Frame** | Frames/iframes | name, src |

**2. Object Identification Properties**

```vbscript
' Browser identification
Browser("title:=Google").Sync
Browser("name:=.*Chrome.*", "regex:=true").Navigate "url"

' Page identification
Page("title:=Login Page").Sync
Page("url:=.*login.*", "regex:=true").Wait

' WebEdit identification
WebEdit("name:=username").Set "user"
WebEdit("html tag:=INPUT", "type:=text").Set "value"
WebEdit("xpath:=//input[@id='user']").Set "admin"

' WebButton identification
WebButton("value:=Submit").Click
WebButton("name:=loginBtn").Click
WebButton("type:=submit", "html tag:=BUTTON").Click

' Link identification
Link("text:=Click Here").Click
Link("url:=.*help.*", "regex:=true").Click

' WebElement with multiple properties
Set desc = Description.Create()
desc("html tag").Value = "DIV"
desc("class").Value = "error-message"
desc("innertext").Value = ".*failed.*"
desc("innertext").RegularExpression = True
Set errorElement = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement(desc)
```

**3. Advanced Locator Strategies**

```vbscript
' CSS Selectors
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("css:=.btn-primary").Click
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("css:=#username").Set "user"
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("css:=input[type='submit']").Click

' XPath
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("xpath:=//div[@class='header']/h1").GetROProperty("innertext")
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("xpath:=//button[contains(text(),'Submit')]").Click

' Dynamic XPath with variables
Function GetElementByText(text)
    Set GetElementByText = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement(_
        "xpath:=//*[contains(text(),'" & text & "')]")
End Function

' Index-based (use sparingly)
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("index:=0").Click ' First element
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("index:=2").Click ' Third element

' Parent-child relationships
Set parentDiv = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("class:=container")
Set childButton = parentDiv.WebElement("class:=btn")
childButton.Click

' Shadow DOM elements
' UFT 2025+ supports Shadow DOM
Browser("App").Page("Page").ShadowRoot("host-id").WebElement("shadow-element").Click
```

**4. Working with Frames and Iframes**

```vbscript
' Switch to frame
Browser("App").Page("Page").Frame("mainFrame").WebEdit("username").Set "user"

' Nested frames
Browser("App").Page("Page").Frame("outer").Frame("inner").WebButton("submit").Click

' Frame by index
Browser("App").Page("Page").Frame("index:=0").WebEdit("field").Set "value"

' Dynamic frame handling
Function GetFrameByName(namePattern)
    Set frames = Browser("App").Page("Page").Frames
    For Each frame in frames
        frameName = frame.GetROProperty("name")
        If InStr(frameName, namePattern) > 0 Then
            Set GetFrameByName = frame
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next
    Set GetFrameByName = Nothing
End Function

' Check if in frame
On Error Resume Next
Browser("App").Page("Page").Frame("unknown").Sync
If Err.Number <> 0 Then
    ' Frame not found
    Err.Clear
End If
```

**5. Child Objects Collection**

```vbscript
' Get all links on page
Set links = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects("class:=Link")
For i = 0 to links.Count - 1
    linkText = links(i).GetROProperty("text")
    Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Link", linkText
Next

' Filter by properties
Set desc = Description.Create()
desc("html tag").Value = "INPUT"
desc("type").Value = "checkbox"
Set checkboxes = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects(desc)

' Get specific element by position
If checkboxes.Count > 2 Then
    checkboxes(2).Set "ON" ' Third checkbox
End If

' Process all images
Set images = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects("class:=Image")
For Each img in images
    alt = img.GetROProperty("alt")
    src = img.GetROProperty("src")
    If alt = "" Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Image", "Missing alt text: " & src
    End If
Next
```

**6. Element State Verification**

```vbscript
' Check existence
If Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("id:=dynamic").Exist(5) Then
    ' Element exists
End If

' Check visibility
If Browser("App").Page("Page").WebButton("submit").GetROProperty("visible") = "True" Then
    ' Button is visible
End If

' Check enabled/disabled
If Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("field").GetROProperty("disabled") = "False" Then
    ' Field is enabled
End If

' Check checked state
If Browser("App").Page("Page").WebCheckBox("agree").GetROProperty("checked") = "True" Then
    ' Checkbox is checked
End If

' Get current value
currentValue = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("field").GetROProperty("value")

' Check CSS properties
color = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("error").GetROProperty("color")
fontSize = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("title").GetROProperty("font-size")
```

**7. Dynamic Element Strategies**

```vbscript
' Strategy 1: Regular expressions
```

content.explanation:
**Advanced Web Waiting Strategies:**

**1. Page Load Synchronization**

```vbscript
' Basic page sync
Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync

' Sync with timeout
If Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(15) Then
    ' Page loaded within 15 seconds
Else
    ' Timeout - handle error
End If

' Wait for specific URL
Function WaitForUrl(expectedUrl, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentUrl = Browser("App").GetROProperty("url")
        If InStr(currentUrl, expectedUrl) > 0 Then
            WaitForUrl = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForUrl = False
End Function

' Wait for document ready state
Function WaitForDocumentReady(timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        readyState = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript("return document.readyState")
        If readyState = "complete" Then
            WaitForDocumentReady = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForDocumentReady = False
End Function
```

**2. AJAX and Dynamic Content**

```vbscript
' Wait for AJAX to complete
Function WaitForAjax(timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        ' Check jQuery active connections

        If CInt(ajaxActive) = 0 Then

                "var count = 0; if (window.XMLHttpRequest) count = 1; return count;")
            If CInt(xhrActive) = 0 Then

    Loop

            WaitForAjax(5)

            Exit Function

    Loop
```

**3. Handling Single Page Applications (SPA)**

```vbscript
            "if (window.angular) {" & _
```
